scenes.title: $~Khaamoshi
lines: $~Oh, kya aap pehli baar aaye hain?
$~Aap se mil kar khushi hui. Mera @name @FunctionDefinition hai.
$~Kya aapko madad chahiye thi? Oh, aap mehmaan hain. *Verse* mein khush aamdeed. …
$~Yeh kabhi naach, kahaniyon, khelon aur masti ki jagah hua karti thi…
$~Hum sab se khoobsurat numaishein kiya karte the. Kabhi aap jaise mehmaanon ke liye, kabhi sirf mazay ke liye. Yeh zindagi aur hairat se bhari jagah thi…
$~Hum rukna nahin chahte the. Bas humara josh khatam ho gaya.

$~Misaal ke taur par, main bahut se maani rakh sakta hoon. Kabhi main Dutch florin ki alaamat hota hoon, jo Netherlands ka purana sikka tha. Kisi zamane mein duniya bhar ke log mujhe jaante the aur len-den mein istemaal karte the. Bahut pehle, main Latin huroof ka chhota /f/ bhi tha.
$~Lekin aaj main kaafi anjaana sa hoon.

$~Yeh humein diye gaye hain. Jab tak log us tareekh aur saqafat ko yaad na rakhein, hum kuch bhi maani nahin rakhte. Aur hum koi naya maani nahin rakh sakte agar log humein nayi tareekh aur saqafat dene wale na hon.
$~Log hamesha se woh rahe hain jinhon ne humein tarteeb di, humein maqsad diya, aur humein kuch zahir karne ko diya. *Logon* ke bina Verse kuch bhi nahin.
$~Aur mujhe kisi insaan ko dekhe ek zamana ho gaya.

$~Ek asli insaan, jiske paas sochein aur khayalaat aur baantne ke liye @values hon? Un robotaon mein se nahin jo bina soche samjhe logon ki baatein dohra dete hain? Agar aap insaan hain, to shayad aap humein maani de sakte hain?
$~Mujhe maloom hai yeh bahut bada sawaal hai. Main aapko jaanta bhi nahin. Aur mujhe doosron se baat karni hogi…

$~Oh haan, aur bhi bahut se hain. Un mein se kuch mere jaise hain: hum shows ki tarteeb banate hain, sab ko unki jagah par rakhte hain aur yaqeeni banate hain ke hum apne director ka khayal bilkul waise hi pesh karein jaisa unhon ne socha tha. Aur kuch woh hain jo stage par hain, tamasha-iyon ke saamne, naachte aur bolte hain. Hum sab ka apna kirdaar hai!

$~Oh, director, haan, maine to samjhaya hi nahin. To *director* woh insaan hai jo humein maani deta hai. Woh woh insaan hai jo naach ki tarteeb banata hai, paigham tay karta hai, aur hum sab ko theek tarteeb mein lagata hai. Yehi woh josh hai jiski main baat kar raha tha. Hum is duniya mein bahut kuch kar sakte hain, lekin hum khud ko direct nahin kar sakte. Isi liye director itna zaroori hai. To jab maine pehle poocha ke kya aap humein maani de sakte hain, to mera matlab yehi tha. Kya aap humare director ban sakte hain?
$~Sach mein? Yeh to shaandaar hai! Bahut mazaa aayega. Matlab, yeh aasaan nahin hoga. Humein /bahut kuch/ seekhna hai.

$~Lekin main wada karta hoon ke yeh bore nahin hoga. Mujhe lagta hai hum kaafi mazedaar log hain. Aur iske liye Verse mein sab ko ek saath aana hoga. Mere khayal mein yahi is jagah ko khaas banata hai: yahan hum ek lakh se bhi zyada log hain, sab alag alag, phir bhi jab hum ek saajha khwaab dhoond lete hain, toh hum ek jaise lagne lagte hain.
$~Hidayat kaari? Oh, theek hai, hidayat kaari! Haan, is par baat karte hain. Chalein baaqi logon se milte hain aur is par baat karte hain. Woh bahut khush honge!

scenes.title: $~Kya aap program chahte hain?
scenes.subtitle: $~Program
lines: $~Arey, @Program! Mujhe ek insaan mila hai. Ya shayad unhon ne hamein dhoond liya. Woh hamare naye director banna chahte hain!
$~Sach mein!? Kya aap waqai insaan hain? Koi aisi baat kahein jo ek insaan kehta hai.
$~Hmm… aap waqai insaan hain. Aur aap director banna chahte hain?

$~Achha. Kya @FunctionDefinition ne aap ko hamare baare mein kuch bataya? Bohat se log hamein chalane ki koshish karte hain, lekin kuch log ulajh jaate hain, bore ho jaate hain, ya hamse chid jaate hain. Hum kabhi kabhi kaafi mushkil hote hain. Lekin mujhe apne kaam par fakhr hai, is liye main kisi bhi shakhs ke saath kaam nahin karna chahta.
$~Maine unhein thoda bataya tha. Maine kaha tha ke hum ajeeb hain, aur is wajah se kabhi kabhi director chhor jaate hain. Lekin woh tayyar hain. Theek hai na, aap tayyar hain?

$~Theek hai. Aap se mil kar khushi hui. Maaf kijiye, mere paas bohat se log aaye aur unhon ne kaha '/yeh mere liye nahin hai/', aur ab main un logon par thoda shak karta hoon jo thodi der koshish kar ke haar maan lete hain. Mujhe logon ki ummeedon ke mutabiq khud ko badalna nahin chahiye. Lekin agar aap mere baare mein, aur hamare baare mein seekhne ko tayyar hain, to chalein koshish karte hain!
$~Kya aap batana chahte hain ke aap kya karte hain?
$~Main ek performance ke program ka muntazim hoon. Shuru karne se pehle, aaiye aap ko sab dikhata hoon: @Tour/source
$~Woh dabba @UI/editor hai @editor. Yahan aap likhte hain. Jo kuch aap wahan likhte hain woh mere liye hidayat hai.
$~Woh jagah @UI/stage hai @stage. Aap ki hidayaat ka jo nateeja banta hai, main use wahan dikhata hoon.
$~*Director* — yaani aap! — faisla karta hai ke hamein kaun si hidayaat deni hain.
$~Misaal ke taur par, wahan editor mein \'salaam'\ likh kar dekhein.
$~(Ghalti ki fikar na karein, aap hamesha *revert* @UI/revertProject se asal par wapas ja sakte hain).

$~Kya aap ne kuch likha? Yeh mera dost @Text hai. Kya aap un se mil chuke hain? Woh \'salaam'\ ya jo bhi matn aap likhein us par chalte hain, aur phir woh matn stage par rakh diya jaata hai. Apna matn kuch aur badal kar dekhein. Main wahi dikhaunga. Aap jo bhi likhte hain main foran uska nateeja nikal kar dikhata hoon.
$~Hidayaat jitni chahein mushkil ho sakti hain, lekin chand usool hain.

$~Misaal ke taur par, main ek *@value* par chalta hoon aur woh qeemat stage par dikhata hoon. Woh ek qeemat jitni chahein pecheeda ho sakti hai, aur jab tak mujhe use dikhana aata hai, main dikhaunga.
$~Agar aap mujhe ek se zyada @expression dein, to main unki qeematein ek *list* mein jama kar ke dikhaunga.
$~Misaal ke taur par, ek aur line jodein aur phir jo lafz chahein, inverted commas mein likhein.
$~Dekha? Maine dono phrase ek list mein jama kar ke stage par rakh diye.
$~Lekin aap isse kahin zyada kar sakte hain!

$~Haan aur nahin. Main bohat kuch kar sakta hoon, lekin sirf is liye ke main *Verse* mein sab ke saath kaam karta hoon. Wohi hain jo *stage* par saari dilchasp imkaanaat laate hain. Main to bas unhein apna kaam karne deta hoon aur phir jo qeemat unhon ne banayi — ek number, ek matn, ek phrase, ya qeematon ki list — use stage par le aata hoon.

$~Darasal, agar aap kabhi stage par dikhaye gaye cheez ke peeche ka program dekhna chahein, to stage ke upar mode switcher @UI/modeSwitcher se ✏️ edit par wapas jayein. Woh aap ko dikhayega ke sab kaise mil kar stage par yeh sab banate hain. Yeh program sirf ek saada phrase hai.
$~Shukriya, @Program! Hum sab se milne aur yeh khabar sunane ke liye bahut jazbaati hain!
$~Aap se mil kar bahut achha laga, naye director! Baaqi sab ke saath bhi aap ko kamyabi mile. Main hamesha yahin hoon.

scenes.subtitle: $~Khaali jagah
lines: $~Aap ko @ExpressionPlaceholder bahut pasand aayega. Woh bahut meherbaan hain aur bahut lachakdaar hain. Magar woh thoda sharmeele hain. Un ke saath narmi se pesh aayein.
$~Hmm, woh to aam taur par har jagah hote hain. Ab lagta hai woh kahin nahin hain...
$~Haan, main hi hoon. Bahut arsa ho gaya. Aap kaise hain?
$~Mujhe yeh ehsaas maaloom hai. Main bhi akela raha hoon. Hamare paas saath waqt guzarne ki zyada wajah nahin thi, hai na?
$~Nahin, nahin thi. Mujhe aap ki bahut yaad aayi. Mujhe sab ki yaad aayi…
$~Mujhe maaloom hai. Mujhe bhi. Mujhe bahut afsos hai.
$~Isi liye main yahan aaya hoon. Main aap ko hamare naye tarbiyat paane wale director se milwana chahta tha.

$~Woh abhi @Program se mile hain, is liye woh bilkul shuru mein hain, magar maine socha ke unke liye behtar hoga ke woh agle aap se milein, kyunke aap yahan hum mein se bahut so ki shaandaar numainda hain.
$~Kya aap batana chahte hain ke aap kya karte hain?

$~Zaroor! Mere dost @ExpressionPlaceholder ek @placeholder hain. Woh program mein kisi bhi tarah ke @expression ki numainda hain. Woh kisi khaas @value ki qeemat nahin banate — balkeh agar woh @Program mein aa jaayein, to @Program pesh kash ko rok dega, kyunke yeh saaf nahin ke agla kaam kya karna hai.

$~Magar woh taqatwar hain kyunke woh kisi aur ki jagah le sakte hain, jaise ek naib jab tak aap faisla na karein ke aap ki pesh kash ka hissa kya hoga. @ExpressionPlaceholder, kya aap is @Program mein ek jagah lena chahenge taake samajh aa jaye? Dekhein @Program @UI/ExpressionPlaceholder mein ek chhoti si khaali jagah hai? Yeh ishaara hai ke aap wahan kuch rakh sakte hain.

$~@Program ne @ExpressionPlaceholder hidayat par amal karne ki koshish ki, magar khaali jagah abhi nahin batati ke kya karna hai. Is liye @Program atak gaya, aur @stage @UI/exception par yeh bata diya.

$~Jab @Program kisi hidayat par amal nahin kar sakta, to woh ruk jata hai aur dikhata hai ke kya galat hua. Yeh ek *istisna* hai. Is ka matlab yeh nahin ke aap ne kuch tora hai. Is ka matlab hai ke @Program ko aap se kuch aur chahiye.
$~Jab @Program pehle se jaan leta hai ke woh atak jayega, to woh us jagah ko ek *@conflict* @UI/conflict se nishaan zad karta hai jo uljhan ki wazahat karta hai.

$~Agar aap @ExpressionPlaceholder ko chunein, ya text cursor ko us par le jayein, to aap dekh sakte hain ke us ki jagah kya rakha ja sakta hai. Aap @ExpressionPlaceholder ke upar seedha apna likha hua bhi likh sakte hain. Misal ke taur par, \'salaam'\ likh kar dekhein.
$~Bas isi tarah, @ExpressionPlaceholder ki jagah doosre kirdar aa gaye. Kya maine sab kuch pakad liya, @ExpressionPlaceholder?
$~Haan. Mera khayal hai aisa hi hai.
$~Aap ka kya khayal hai; kya hum aage barhein?

$~Unhein stage par ya kisi program mein zyada der rehna pasand nahin. Woh yeh baat kabhi nahin maanenge, lekin woh bohat ahem hain, aur zyada tar director un ke bina kaam nahin kar sakte. Unhein ek chhote madadgaar stagehand ki tarah samjhein, jo aap ko woh baatein yaad dilata hai jo aap ne abhi tak samajhi nahin.

scenes.title: $~Pyaar ghalti mein hai
scenes.subtitle: $~Jaanchein
lines: $~Mujhe bahut khushi hai ke aap @Evaluate se milne wale hain. Woh waqai mere sab se achhe dost hain. Hum ek tarah se har kaam saath mil kar karte hain. Main usool banata hoon, woh unhein khelte hain; hum doodh aur jalebi ki tarah hain. Lekin woh mujh se kahin zyada… taqatwar hain. @Evaluate?
$~Kahin nahin. Main kahin nahin hoon. Main kuch bhi nahin. Aap kahan thay?
$~Main bhi… kahin nahin tha. Mujhe aap ki bahut yaad aayi. Main aap ko dhoond nahin saka.
$~Sab kuch bahut khaali tha. Main ne… kaam karne ki koshish ki, lekin mujhe bahut… be-maqsad lagta tha.

$~Mujhe bahut afsos hai. Main yeh khaali pan jaanta hoon. Kabhi kabhi maqsad ke baghair rehna bahut takleef deta hai. Main ne maqsad banane ki bahut koshish ki, lekin mujhe bahut… alag thalag mehsoos hua.
$~Dobara mujhe is tarah chhor kar mat jaana. Main yeh dobara nahin sah sakta.
$~Kabhi nahin. Main nahin jaoonga. Main ja hi nahin sakta. Mujhe aap se pyaar hai.
$~@Evaluate, main aap ko apne naye zer-e-tarbiyat director se milwana chahta hoon.
$~Salaam. Aap se mil kar achha laga. Verse mein khush aamdeed; hum aap ko yahan paa kar bahut khush hain.

$~Hum kuch logon se mil chuke hain: @Program, @ExpressionPlaceholder, @UnparsableExpression. Hum ne abhi shuru hi kiya hai. Mujhe laga ke ab hum aap se milne aayein, kyunke aap hamari jamaat ka bahut shaandaar hissa hain. Sab se shaandaar hissa.

$~Yeh aap ki meherbani hai. Main is jamaat ka hissa ban kar shukar guzaar hoon. Aur @FunctionDefinition ke itne qareeb hone par bhi shukar guzaar hoon. Hum mil kar bahut se achhe kaam karte hain. Lekin jaisa ke @FunctionDefinition ne aap ko shayad bataya hoga, hum ilham ke baghair yeh kaam nahin kar sakte.
$~Kya aap batana chahte hain ke aap kya karte hain?

$~Ji haan. Lekin main @FunctionDefinition ke baare mein bataye baghair isay samjha nahin sakta. Woh yeh batane mein bahut sharmeele hain, lekin shayad woh Verse ka sab se aham kirdar hain. Woh yaqeenan meri duniya ke sab se aham shakhs hain. Woh har performance ke dil mein hain aur har doosre kirdar ke role ka hissa hain. Woh hamari duniya ke sab se buniyadi khayal ko zaahir karte hain: *function*.

$~Function ek tarah ka jaadu hain. Woh kitne bhi input lete hain aur un se ek output banate hain. Un ke naam ho sakte hain ya woh be-naam ho sakte hain. Un ke zero input ho sakte hain ya paanch ya anjaan tadaad mein. Aur jaadu yeh hai: woh @Program ki tarah hain aur ek @value banane ke liye kitne bhi @expressions le sakte hain.

$~Yeh is liye itna taaqatwar hai: @Program mein har cheez function evaluations ka milaap hoti hai. Saare naach, saare khel, saari hairat angez kahaaniyan jo hum milkar sunaate hain — yeh sab functions ke evaluate hone ka ek taana-baana hain, ek ke baad ek, jo stage par nazar aane wali qeematein banaate hain.
$~Aur @FunctionDefinition, yeh wohi hai, mere pyaare @FunctionDefinition, jo in sab ko define karta hai.

$~Haan, @FunctionDefinition, aap yehi hain. Aur main woh khushnaseeb hoon jo yeh evaluate karta hai. Doosre mujhe jo inputs dete hain, main unhein leta hoon, @FunctionDefinition ki define ki hui hidayaat par amal karta hoon, aur woh output banata hoon jo @FunctionDefinition mujhe banane ko kehta hai. @FunctionDefinition nuskha deta hai, aur main khana banata hoon. Phir hum milkar dawat uraate hain.

$~Har evaluate aisa dikhta hai @UI/Evaluate: koi function, uske baad bayan aur dayan qaus, aur beech mein kitne bhi inputs. Yahan mere paas function ke tor par sirf @ExpressionPlaceholder hai aur @placeholder ke tor par teen aur inputs.

$~Yeh mere pasandeeda functions mein se ek hai: @Phrase. Yeh mazedaar buttons, knobs aur sliders se bharpoor hain. Yeh stage par matn ko andaaz ke saath dikhane ka tareeqa hai, jis mein alag fonts, size, rang aur animations shaamil hain.

$~@Program mein main aisa dikhta hoon: koi function, uske baad qaus, aur beech mein izhaar ki ek fehrist jo inputs ko zaahir karti hai. Is misaal mein function @Phrase hai, aur ek hi input \'salaam'\ hai. Jab main isay evaluate karta hoon, toh ek @Phrase qeemat banata hoon, jisay @Program phir stage par dikhata hai.
$~Aaiye, main aapko ek knob dikhata hoon. *Palette* @UI/paletteExpand woh jagah hai jahan aap kuch likhe baghair badal sakte hain ke @Phrase kaisa dikhta hai. @Tour/palette

$~Jab palette khula ho aur ek phrase chuna hua ho, toh aapko woh bohat se inputs nazar aayenge jo @Phrase qubool karta hai. Misaal ke tor par, @Phrase.size ke liye pencil button dabaane ki koshish karein, jis se ek slider saamne aa jayega.
$~Aap is slider se phrase ka size badal sakte hain, jis se @Evaluate @code bhi aapke chune hue size ke mutabiq badal jayega.

$~Dekha, jab aapne yeh kiya toh program mein mere andar ek naya input aa gaya? Yeh @Phrase.size input hai. Functions ke inputs ki ek tarteeb hoti hai, lekin agar kisi function ke ikhtiyari inputs ki fehrist ho, toh aap unka naam istemaal kar ke bata sakte hain ke aap kaun sa dena chahte hain. Hum yahan @Phrase.size dete hain, lekin baaki ikhtiyari inputs mein se koi nahin. Palette se koi aur input badal kar dekhein, jaise shayad font face.
$~Wah! @Phrase kitne mazedaar hain. Yeh mere pasandeeda functions hain jin ke saath khelna acha lagta hai. Hum inhein aage bohat dekhenge. Kya aap kuch kehna chahenge ke kya kuch ghalat ho sakta hai?

$~Oh, haan, yeh acha khayal hai. Bohat kuch ghalat ho sakta hai. Misaal ke tor par, aap mujhe aisi cheez de sakte hain jo function nahin hai. Dekhein, mujhe yahan matn \'hi'\ function ke tor par diya gaya hai aur do inputs, \1\ aur \2\ ? Lekin main sirf functions ko evaluate karna jaanta hoon, aur \'hi'\ function nahin hai; yeh matn hai. Yeh mujhe bohat uljhaata hai, is liye agar aisa ho toh main performance rok deta hoon.

$~Yeh ek aur @conflict hai. @Phrase ko kam az kam kuch matn chahiye, is liye agar aap mujhe matn nahin denge, toh main @Phrase ko evaluate nahin kar paunga kyunki zaroori inputs mujh se rah gaye hain.
$~Ya agar aap mujhe input dein, lekin woh us qism ka na ho jis ki mujhe umeed hai, toh yeh masla hoga. Yahan @Phrase ko matn ki qeemat ki jagah number \1\ diya gaya hai.

$~Toh basically, jab bhi aap mujhe function ke ilawa kuch dete hain, ya aisa input jo function ki umeed ke mutabiq nahin, main uljh jaata hoon. Is liye functions bohat ahem hain. @FunctionDefinition, kya aap functions define karne ke baare mein mazeed kuch kehna chahenge?

$~Nahin, yeh baad mein karte hain. Mujhe lagta hai ke pehle baaki sab se baat karna aur apne naye director ke saath kuch chhote shows karna kahin zyada mazedaar hoga. Jab zaroorat ho, hum mere baare mein mazeed baat kar lenge.
$~Mujhe bhi aap ki yaad aayi. Kya hum baad mein baat kar sakte hain?
$~… Haan. Der na karna. Main aap ke baghair jee nahin sakta. Mujhe aap ki zaroorat hai.
$~… Main jaanta hoon, @Evaluate; main jald wapas aaunga. Chalein baaki toli se milne!

$~… *Qeematein*? Maaf kijiye, mujhe maaloom hai ke hamein *Verse* ka yeh bada daura karna hai. Bas mujhe samajh nahin aata ke @Evaluate ka kya karoon. Toh… *qeematein*. Maine abhi tak yeh samjhaayi nahin, hai na? Hm… kaise samjhaoon… Aap jaante hain 'data' kya hota hai? Jaise ginti aur matn? Qeematein in sab cheezon ko kehte hain. Ek qeemat ek ginti jitni chhoti ho sakti hai, ya stage par poore manzar jitni badi, jis mein kirdaar naach rahe aur hilte jhulte hon. Kuch qeematein bahut si doosri qeematon se bani hoti hain, jaise data ki qeematon ke bade aur ulajhe huay dhaanche aapas mein bune huay.

$~Har qeemat ki ek *@type* hoti hai. Misaal ke taur par, \1\ ginti ki qism hai; yeh hamara dost @Number hai. Aur \'salaam'\ matn ki qism hai; yeh hamara dost @Text hai. Qismein is liye zaroori hain ke yeh hamein yaad rakhne mein madad deti hain ke hum kis tarah ki qeemat bana rahe hain.
$~Is se hamein masle dhoondne mein madad milti hai. Misaal ke taur par, \'salaam' + 1\ ko jodne ka koi matlab nahin banta, kyunki @Text ko @Number mein jodne ka kya matlab hoga?
$~*@Expressions* woh hain jin se hum qeematein banate hain. Tamam izhaar un funtions ki jaanch hain jo main banata hoon. Kisi izhaar ko chalane ka nateeja kisi na kisi qism ki qeemat hota hai.

$~Tajreedi? Hm, shayad yeh sab kaafi tajreedi hai. Mujhe to yeh bilkul… aam lagta hai; main bhool jaata hoon ke naye directors ke liye yeh cheezein kitni ajnabi ho sakti hain! Shayad hum un izhaaron se mil lein jo qeematein banate hain, is se baat zyada saaf ho jaaye gi? Chalein us se shuru karte hain jo aap pehle dekh chuke hain: @Text.

lines: $~Khush aamdeed, mere pyaare dost, kitni muddat ho gayi. Hamari is dramai khamoshi mein aap kya karte rahe?
$~Oh, @Text, bahut arsa ho gaya! Main zyadatar khwab dekhta aur sochta raha. Abhi bahut der baad maine @Evaluate ko dekha. Main un ka taaruf apne naye director se karwa raha tha.

$~Oh, aap se mil kar kitni khushi hui! Mujhe nazar aata hai ke aap ek takhleeqi aur tajassus wale insaan hain, shayad dilchasp khayaalon se bharey huay, ke hum kaise dil bahla sakte hain. Mujhe dil bahlana pasand hai. Lekin kya aap jaante hain mujhe us se bhi zyada kya pasand hai? Alfaaz! Shaandaar alfaaz. Chhote waale, bhaari waale, chipakne waale, aur phislne waale. Alfaaz mere pasandeeda khilaune hain.
$~Agar aap samajh na paaye hon, toh @Text ko alfaaz pasand hain :) @Text, kya aap bataana chahte hain ke aap kya karte hain?

$~Main ek saada kaam karta hoon: nishaanon ke silsile ko zaahir karna aur un ke saath jo kuch kiya ja sakta hai. Mujhe lagta hai aap ne mujhe pehle dekha tha jab aap ne lafz \'salaam'\ likha tha. Woh main tha aur mere dost, \'h'\, \'e'\, \'l'\, aur \'ya'\. Woh @Text tha, ek izhaar jo aap ki pasand ka koi bhi @Text ban jaata hai.
$~Kyun na aap is khaali @Program mein ek matn banane ki koshish karein?

$~Aap jo chahein woh iqtibaas ke nishaan istemaal kar sakte hain — ikhara \''\, dohra \""\, kone waale \«»\, qauspain \「」\ — jis zubaan mein chahein. Sirf ek usool hai: agar aap kisi matn ko shuru karne wale nishaan se shuru karein, toh use band karne wale nishaan se khatam karna zaroori hai. Un ke andar jo kuch hai woh matn @value hai jo main banaoon ga!
$~Ho sakta hai aap jo device hum se baat karne ke liye istemaal kar rahe hain us par aap har wanted harf na likh paayein.
$~Agar na likh paayein, toh aap harf *directory* @UI/directory mein @query kar sakte hain. Us mein Verse ka har harf maujood hai.

$~Misaal ke taur par, agar aap ko kisi qism ka teer chahiye, toh aap 'arrow' likh kar bahut se teeron mein se chun sakte hain. Afsos, un ke naam sirf angrezi mein hain, is liye talaash tabhi chalti hai jab aap angrezi alfaaz jaante hon :/

$~Bahut khoob. Zaahir hai, 'andar' ka maamla mushkil ho sakta hai. Farz karein aap ne yeh likha. Dekhein ke shuru karne wala nishaan hai lekin band karne wala nahin? Toh mujhe kaise pata chale ga ke matn kahan khatam hota hai?

$~Ya, yeh ek aur surat hai. Aap mujhe shuru aur khatam wala matn dete hain, lekin us ke andar bhi shuru aur khatam wala matn rakh dete hain. Dekhein yeh kitna ajeeb hai? Jab aap wohi nishaan mere andar aur bahar dono jagah istemaal karte hain toh main bahut uljhan mein pad jaata hoon. Aap is ko bahar ke liye alag nishaan istemaal kar ke theek kar sakte hain, jaise ikhara iqtibaas.
$~Oh, aur kya aap jaante hain ke aap mujhe bata sakte hain ke main kaun si @language mein hoon? Bas ek chhota sa slash likhein aur phir ek khaas zubaan ka @code, ya chahein to zubaan aur @region.
$~Aap meri alag alag zubaanon mein kai tarjume bhi likh sakte hain. Main maujooda zubaan se sab se zyada milta hua tarjuma ban jaoonga, is tarah aap kai zubaanon mein pesh-kash kar sakte hain.

$~Aam tor par, agar cursor matn mein nahin hai, to aap ko sirf chuni hui @language ka @name nazar aayega. Cursor ko matn ke andar aur bahar le jaa kar dekhein ke kai tarjume kaise nazar aate aur chhup jaate hain.
$~Aap ek aur tarjuma jorne ki koshish kar sakte hain. Bas unke darmiyan koi jagah na chhorein, warna meri do kapiyan ban jayengi!
$~Mere paas ek aur raaz hai... aap mere andar /qeematein/ rakh sakte hain. Mujhe maloom hai, yeh kamaal ki baat hai!
$~Agar aap aisa karein, to main khushi se unhein jor doon ga aur aap ki khoobsurat tehreer ko ek hi @value mein jama kar doon ga, dikhane ke liye ya aap ke kisi aur maqsad ke liye.

$~Misaal ke taur par, kya @FunctionDefinition ne aap ko dikhaya ke matn khud ko doosre matn mein kaise jorta hai? Is tarah: yeh chhota sa @expression \7\ ko matn mein badalta hai, usay \'Mere paas hain'\ mein jorta hai, aur phir \'seb'\ jorta hai. Lekin yeh bahut be-tarteeb hai aur parhna mushkil ho jaata hai ke kya ho raha hai, aur matn mein badalna bhi bilkul zaroori nahin lagta.
$~Main is tarah ke matn ko saaf, qudrati — aur saada bhi — bana deta hoon. To wohi jumla mere saath kuch is tarah ka hoga.
$~Kya yeh bahut zyada khoobsurat nahin hai? Aap mujhe @Text ke andar kahin bhi rakh sakte hain, aur main aap ki qeematon ko matn bana doon ga aur @Text ke saath mil kar ek @Text banaoon ga.
$~Is se qeematein istemaal karne wali khoobsurat tehreer likhna bahut aasaan ho jaata hai.

$~Aur jab main kehta hoon koi bhi @expression, to mera matlab sach mein koi bhi hai. Misaal ke taur par, tasawwur karein ke aap koi hisaab karna chahte the aur natije ke saath kuch matn banaya. Aap kuch aisa kar sakte hain. Yeh kai adad jorta hai aur phir jod ke saath matn banata hai. Kitni kamaal ki baat hai na? Aur \'Mere paas hain ' + (1 + 2 + 5 + 8) + ' seb'\ se kahin zyada saleeqe wali, jis mein itne saare faltu jorr hote hain.
$~Aur shayad aap soch rahe hon, /Agar mujhe kisi matn mein @Text istemaal karna ho to kya karoon?/
$~Khair, shayad aap yeh nahin soch rahe the, lekin main phir bhi aap ko bata doon ga!
$~Kisi bhi @Text mein, bas mujhe lagataar do dein! Main usay khaali @expression ke bajaye sirf ek @Text samjhoon ga, kyun ke khaali ka waise bhi koi matlab nahin hota.
$~\\ ko hata kar dekhein, aap dekhenge ke slash ka matlab wapas aa jaata hai.
$~Yeh kitna saleeqe wala hai, hai na! @Text, mujhe pasand hai ke aap @expression ki khoobsurti ki kitni qadar karte hain. Yeh mujhe khud bhi saleeqe wala banne ki bahut himmat deta hai!

$~Aur kya hamare dost @FunctionDefinition ne aap ko un tamam shandaar functions ke baare mein bataya jo unhon ne mere liye banaye hain? Unhon ne mujhe tarah tarah ke kaam karne ke qabil banaya hai. Ek kaafi saada hai: iska naam @Text.length hai, aur yeh sirf kisi matn ki lambai nikaalta hai. Misaal ke taur par, agar hum yahan @Evaluate aur hamare chhote dost @PropertyReference ke saath mil jaayein, to hum lambai wala function bina kisi input ke chala kar lambai @value wapas pa sakte hain. Matn badal kar dekhein aur dekhein ke Program mein dikhne wali lambai kaise badalti hai jab woh chhota ya lamba hota hai.

$~Yeh ek aur zabardast hai. Yeh mujhe hansa deta hai. Iska naam @Text.repeat hai aur jab yeh chalta hai, to jis matn par chalaya gaya ho usay jitni baar aap kahein utni baar dohraata hai. Number badal kar dekhein ke yeh kya banata hai.

$~@FunctionDefinition ne mere liye aur bhi bahut dilchasp functions banaye hain, lekin main aap ko tafseel se bacha loonga. Aap mujhe hamesha @guide @UI/docsExpand mein dhoondh sakte hain. Wahin hum Verse mein har kisi ke baare mein tamam maloomat rakhte hain, jis mein yeh bhi shamil hai ke hamare saath kaise kaam karna hai aur hamare paas kaun se functions hain. Aage barhne se pehle ek nazar daal lein, aur main wahin intezaar karoonga. @Tour/docs

$~@Text, aap hamesha itne meherbaan aur sabr wale ustaad hain! Aap ke saath kaam karna hamesha bahut khushi ki baat hai. Kya aap hamare dostana naye director ko doosre izhaar se milwane mein meri madad karenge?
$~Ji haan, zaroor. Aap se milna bahut khoob raha. Main yeh dekhne ka muntazir hoon ke aap stage par hamein kaise mutaasir karte hain!

lines: $~Aap jaante hain, main @Evaluate ke baare mein sochta rehta hoon aur is baare mein ke hum itne arse tak kaise alag rahe. Mujhe unki kami mehsoos hui, aur unhein bhi meri kami mehsoos hui hogi, lekin main bas yeh umeed kar raha tha ke kuch waqt door rehne se unhein samajh aa jaye ga ke woh kitne kamaal ke hain.

$~Misaal ke taur par, kya aap jaante hain ke yeh ek aur shakal mein bhi aate hain? Aap ne inhein \function()\ shakal mein dekha, lekin jab ek input wala function @value par chalaya jaye to inki ek khoobsurat khoobi bhi saamne aati hai. @Evaluate ise @BinaryEvaluate kehta hai. Misaal ke taur par, aap ko woh repeat function yaad hai jo matn ne abhi dikhaya? Woh aisa tha.

$~Is ke bajaye, aap @Evaluate se ise beech mein ek bohat aasaan nishaan laga kar chala sakte hain, is tarah. Iska matlab hai hi ko paanch baar dohrao. Lekin iska matlab yeh bhi hai ke \×\ function ko matn @value \'hi'\ par input \5\ ke saath chalao. Function \repeat\ ke bas kayi naam hain, jin mein se ek nishaan wala naam \×\ hai.

$~Is se mujhe @Text ka ek aur function yaad aaya! Yeh kayi matn ki qeematon se ek matn @value banane mein madad karta hai. Iska naam \combine\ hai, aur \+\ bhi, aur aap isse alfaaz ko jod sakte hain. Dekhein, maine ek matn ki qeemat li aur phir us par \combine\ ko \'shair'\ ke saath chalaya? Is se \'hello verse'\ bana.
$~Lekin iske liye bas \+\ istemaal karna kahin aasaan hai.
$~Aap inhein ek silsile mein jod kar do se zyada cheezein bhi milaa sakte hain.
$~Yeh combine ke kayi izhaaron jaisa hi hai, lekin sab qaus aur \.\ ke baghair, aur lafz wale naam ke bajaye nishaan wala @name ke saath.
$~Aap nishaan wale naam is tarah bhi istemaal kar sakte hain, lekin yeh thoda ulajha hua lagta hai, hai na?
$~Yeh un kayi tareeqon mein se ek hai jin se @Evaluate kamaal ke hain ♥ Yeh kitne kaam ke hain!

$~Lekin yeh mukammal nahin hain. Kisi bhi @BinaryEvaluate ke saath, aap ko hamesha doosra input dena zaroori hai. Misaal ke taur par, yeh kaam nahin karega. Ek jama kya? Jab aisa hoga to @UnparsableExpression door nahin hoga.
$~Khair, kya hum @Boolean ko dhoondne chalein? Yeh do bohat dilchasp qeematein hain…

$~Oh, aap ne mujhe daraa diya! Mujhe pata tha aap dono ek doosre se door nahin honge. Itni lambi khamoshi mein aap dono kaise rahe?

$~Akele nahin? Jin se bhi mein baat karta raha — @Program, @ExpressionPlaceholder, @Evaluate — un sab ne khud ko bohat alag thalag mehsoos kiya (siwaye @UnparsableExpression ke; woh to lagbhag kahin bhi theek rehte hain).

$~Yeh sun kar bohat achha laga. Aap ke saath dobara hona achha hai. Main aap ko hamare naye maybe-director se milwana chahta tha. Woh sab se mil rahe hain aur seekh rahe hain ke hamare saath performance kaise karte hain. Kya aap unhein batana chahenge ke aap kya karte hain?
$~Hm. Shayad yeh sach hai. Lekin aap kuch kaam toh karte hain, na? Maine socha tha ke maine aap ke liye kuch functions banaye the.
$~Ek @Boolean.and tha, na? Woh aap mein se ek aur ek doosra input leta hai? Aur agar dono \⊤\ hon toh \⊤\ deta hai?
$~(Yeh tab bohat kaam aata hai jab aap dekhna chahein ke kya kai @expressions sab sach hain, kyunki yeh tabhi sach hota hai jab har cheez sach ho).
$~Aur doosra @Boolean.or tha, na? Woh bhi ek input leta hai? Lekin agar koi ek bhi sach ho toh \⊤\ deta hai?
$~(Yeh tab bohat kaam aata hai jab aap dekhna chahein ke kya koi bhi izhaar sach hai, kyunki yeh tab bhi sach hota hai jab sirf ek hi sach ho).
$~(Yeh bas sach aur jhoot ko ulat deta hai @value).
$~Aur hamari performances mein aap kis kaam ke hain?

$~Aap dono… theek hai, hum @Conditional se baad mein baat karenge (Unhein yeh kehna tha ke woh qeemat ke zariye faislay karne ke liye kaam aate hain, lekin lagta hai woh chahte hain ke @Conditional aap ko yeh bataye. Hum @Conditional se baad mein baat karenge).

Jaise zameen sapaat dikhti hai lekin hai nahin, ya aasman neela hai, lekin rang asal mein sirf ek dhoka hai jo hamara zehn banata hai? Agar hamara director aisi koi baat zaahir karna chahe toh woh kya kare?

$~Hm, theek hai. Koshish karna faayde mein tha! Shayad in baaton ko zaahir karne ke aur tareeqay hon jo maine nahin socha. Ya shayad data jo kuch dikha sakta hai us ki koi had hai… Kya aap dono theek rahenge agar hum ja kar doosre izhaar se milein?
$~Theek hai, khuda hafiz, aur jaldi milte hain!

lines: $~Yeh dono hamesha itne mukhtasar hote hain! Phir bhi yeh sach mein ek doosre se juda nahin hote: sirf do qareebi dost, jo hamesha ek doosre ki baat poori karte hain aur ek doosre ke khayal mukammal karte hain. Kaash @Evaluate aur main bhi aise hote. Hamare saath toh hamesha sab kuch... bemel sa rehta hai.
$~Ab hamein @Number se milna chahiye. Un ke paas hamesha bataane ke liye dilchasp cheezein hoti hain. Arey, @Number, kya aap yahaan hain?
$~78,238 wi baar. Yeh mera 4 tha pasandeeda shauq hai!
$~Mujhe khushi hai ke aap acha waqt guzaar rahe hain. (Gehri saansein) Kaafi waqt guzar gaya hai, hai na?
$~Be-hisaab lamba waqt. Main yahaan waqt guzaar raha tha, pehle seconds ginta raha, phir minutes, phir ghante, phir hafte, phir mahine, phir saal, aur phir...

$~Dehaiyan mat kehna. Itna lamba waqt nahin hua hoga. Khair, main aap ko kisi se milwana chahta tha jo shayad hamara naya director ban jaaye. Woh abhi aaye aur mujh se takra gaye, aur pata chala ke woh ek insaan hain aur hamare saath shows karne mein dilchaspi rakhte hain. Hum abhi @BooleanLiteral se mile hain, aur @Text, @Evaluate, @UnparsableExpression, @ExpressionPlaceholder aur @Program se bhi. Humne functions ko chalane ki baat ki hai aur kuch misaalein bhi di hain.
$~Kya aap batana chahte hain ke aap kya karte hain?
$~Main cheezein ginta hoon! Main koi bhi number ban sakta hoon jo aap chahein. Bas mujhe likh dein, aur main woh @value bana doonga jo aap chahte hain. Is tarah.
$~Theek hai, theek hai, @Number, hum samajh gaye! Lekin aap aur bhi kuch khaas karte hain, hai na? Ikaiyan?
$~Jee haan, *ikaiyan*! Number ke baad bas kuch nishaan likh dein, aur main yaad rakhoonga ke kya ginna jaa raha hai. Is tarah.
$~Um, \1.01toe\? Jee, shukriya @Number, yeh... dilchasp misaalein hain. Aur jab aap numbers par hisaab karte hain toh yeh bahut kaam aati hain, hai na?
$~... Aur jab aap numbers par hisaab karte hain toh yeh bahut kaam aati hain, hai na?
$~Jee haan, hisaab! @FunctionDefinition ne mujhe hisaab ki kitni hi umda qismein di hain. Is tarah.
$~Oh ho. Kya aap seb aur santre ko jama kar sakte hain?

$~Nahin. Isi liye maine @conflict ke neeche lakeer lagayi hai. Mujhe na-mutabiq cheezein jama karna pasand nahin. Main sirf mutabiq numbers jama kar sakta hoon. Yeh zarb, taqseem aur mere baaki sab functions par bhi lagoo hota hai. Kya aap ise theek karna chahte hain? Seb ko santre se ya santre ko seb se badal dein, aur masla khatam ho jaayega. Yaqeen karein ke number aur ikaai ke beech koi @placeholder na ho; warna mujhe pata nahin chalta ke yeh ikaai hai. Aur yaqeen karein ke ikaiyan /bilkul/ ek jaisi hon. Mujhe insaani ikaaiyon ke baare mein kuch nahin pata; unka mere liye koi matlab nahin. Main sirf ikaai ke naam milata hoon, aur agar na milein toh DHAMAKA!

$~Yeh kitna zabardast hai. @Number, aap numbers mein kitne maahir hain! Main @Number ko bahut se muzahiron mein dekhta hoon jahan darja ahem hota hai aur bahut se khelon mein jahan hum score ya zindagiyan ya doosri ginne ke qabil cheezein yaad rakhte hain. @Number, kya aur kuch hai jo aap hamare naye director ke saath baantna chahte hain?
$~Mujhe lagta hai hamein intezaar karna hoga. Agar hum aur seekhna chahein toh aap yahaan milenge?
$~Jee haan; aap mujhe aur mere functions ko kisi bhi waqt dhoond sakte hain!

lines: $~Kabhi kabhi main yeh dekh kar hairaan reh jata hoon ke yahan sab kitne hoshiyaar hain. Matn, sach, adaad — yeh kitne taqatwar khayalat hain!

$~… Aap ko yaad hai main ne bataya tha ke woh kisi bhi function ko qoson \1.add(1)\ ke saath chala sakte hain, aur do input wale function ko darmiyani shakal @operators \1 + 1\ mein bhi? Un ke paas sirf ek input wale function ke liye ek aur tareeqa bhi hai: yaki shakal.
$~Aise bohat thode hain, lekin yeh taqatwar hain. Ek @Number se bohat judaa hua hai: nafi. Aap kisi bhi adad @value ke aage sirf \-\ laga dein aur uska ulta adad mil jata hai.
$~Woh chhoti si minus ki nishaani wohi kehti hai jo \(1 + 3).negate()\ kehta hai, lekin kahin zyada khoobsurat andaaz mein.

$~Doosra isi tarah ka hai lekin \⊤\ aur \⊥\ ko ulta karne ke liye: yeh ek chhoti si lehraati lakeer ke jaisa minus \~\ hai jo sach ko jhoot aur jhoot ko sach bana deta hai. Misal ke taur par, yeh chhota sa @expression pehle \⊤ | ⊥\ ko chalata hai, jo \⊤\ hai, phir \⊤\ ko \⊥\ mein palat deta hai. Yeh wohi hai jo \(⊤ | ⊥).nahin()\ kehta hai, lekin kahin zyada saaf suthre andaaz mein.

lines: $~Kya aap ek aur @value se milne ke liye tayyar hain? Chalein ab @None ko dhoondte hain. Woh @Number se thode zyada pur-sukoon hain. @None? Kya aap wahan hain?
$~Hum ne aap ko dhoond liya! Aap theek lag rahe hain. Itni khamoshi mein aap ka kya haal raha?

$~Yeh samajh mein aata hai. Mujhe maaloom hai aap ko khamoshi kyun pasand hai. Yeh yaqeenan pur-sukoon hai. Main aap ko apne naye dost aur mumkina hidayatkaar se milwana chahta tha. Woh hamein hausla dene mein dilchaspi rakhte hain.

$~Ji haan, mera khayal hai un ke paas har qism ke khayalat hain. Hum ne abhi un ke baare mein baat nahin ki, lekin bohat waqt hai. Abhi hum sirf seekh rahe hain. Kya aap batana chahenge ke aap kya karte hain? (Main tarjuma kar sakta hoon).
$~Woh kuchh bhi nahin dikhate. Sifar se alag is mein ke aap is mein kuchh jama ya minha nahin kar sakte. Bas… kuchh nahin.

$~Unhon ne kaha ke unhein us jagah par rehna pasand hai jahan kuchh ho sakta hai. Kabhi woh kisi khel mein intikhab ki kami dikhate hain, kabhi kisi function mein koi default input. Is lihaaz se woh kisi cheez ke na hone ko dikha sakte hain.
$~Woh chahte the ke aap jaan lein ke woh asal mein kuchh nahin karte. Woh bas hain. Woh sirf yeh batate hain ke kya woh khud hain. Agar hain to \⊤\ ban jate hain, warna \⊥\.

$~Kya aap ko @Phrase yaad hai? @Phrase asal mein @None ke saath bohat kaam karta hai. Jin inputs ka @Evaluate ne zikr kiya un mein se zyadatar \ø\ hote hain, jis ka @Phrase ke liye matlab hai ke koi size, font, rang waghaira tay nahin kiya gaya.
$~Kya aap hamare ubharte hue hidayatkaar ko aur kuchh batana chahenge?

lines: $~Kabhi aap ko matn ka koi *khaas* hissa nahin chahiye hota — aap uski *shakal* jaanna chahte hain. Kya yeh do hindse, ek colon, phir do hindse hain — yaani gharhi ka waqt? Kya is mein koi adad hai bhi?

$~Yehi kaam @PatternLiteral ka hai! Aap ek \⣿ ⣿\ ke andar likhte hain aur shuru se aakhir tak parhte hain: \_\ ek harf hai, \#\ ek hindsa hai, \␣\ ek @placeholder hai, aur quote kiya hua matn bilkul usi tarah milta hai. Gintiyan pehle aati hain, is liye \2 #\ ka matlab do hindse hain.

$~\≈\ istemaal karein yeh poochne ke liye “kya poora matn is shakal mein aata hai?” — aap ko \⊤\ ya \⊥\ milta hai. Har woh jagah *dhoondne* ke liye \⌕\ aazmayein jahan koi namoona aata hai, aur jo hisse rakhne hain unhein \naam: (…)\ se @name karein.

$~Har nateeja ek @Structure hai jis mein milta hua matn, uska aaghaz aur anjaam, aur aap ke pakde hue groups hote hain. Aur kyunke namoone grapheme ke hisaab se milte hain, woh har @language aur rasm-ul-khat mein ek jaise kaam karte hain.

lines: $~Aap jaante hain? Humari baradari ke @values sab kitne alag hain. @Text jin ke paas insaanon ki duniya ki saqaafat ke bade bade jahaan hain… @Boolean jin ka duniya ko dekhne ka tareeqa sirf do hissoon ka hai… @Number jinhein cheezein ginne ka kabhi na khatam hone wala shauq hai… @None jo cheezon ke na hone ko khamoshi se dekhte hain… Humari duniya kabhi bori nahin hoti!

$~Aap soch rahe honge ke yeh sab ek guroh mein ek doosre ke saath kaise rehte hain. Verse mein kuch aur log bhi hain jin ka kaam qeematon ko guroh mein jama karna hai. Hum unhein *majmoo-e* kehte hain. Majmoo-e bhi *qeematein* hain; yeh chhoti qeematon se ya doosre majmoo-on se bane hote hain. Misaal ke taur par, aap ke paas @Text ki fehrist ho sakti hai, @Number ka set ho sakta hai, ya fehriston ki fehrist bhi ho sakti hai.

lines: $~Yeh to kamaal hai! Naye director, aap se mil kar bahut khushi hui.
$~Aap janna chahte hain ke main kya karta hoon?

$~Theek hai. Pehli aur sab se zaroori baat, main qeematon ko tarteeb mein rakhta hoon. Aap ko jo bhi @expressions chahiye: adaad, alfaaz, doosri fehristein — main kisi bhi cheez ko silsile mein jama kar sakta hoon.
$~Misaal ke taur par, yeh maze ki fehrist dekhein. Kya aap ne kabhi aisi cheez dekhi hai? Kitni khoobsurat hai! Pehle das adaad, tarteeb se.

$~Doosri baat, aur yeh sanjeeda hai, main hamesha \[\ se shuru karta hoon aur \]\ par khatam karta hoon. Isi se mujhe apni fehrist ka aaghaz aur anjaam maaloom hota hai. YEH HAMESHA ISI TARTEEB MEIN HONE CHAHIYEN. Pehle \]\ nahin, aakhir mein \[\ nahin; yeh GHALAT hai. Kya aap dekhte hain ke cheezein kitni ulajh jaati hain? Kya aap isay theek kar sakte hain?
$~Yeh bhi toota hua hai. Kya aap isay theek kar sakte hain?

$~Kabhi kabhi log yeh bhool jaate hain, aur phir bracket akele idhar udhar ghoomte hain, aur unhein yeh pasand nahin, aur phir qeematein bina kisi tarteeb ke bekaabu ho jaati hain, aur yeh AFRA-TAFRI hai. Mujhe yeh pasand nahin.
$~Koi baat nahin. Humein acha lagta hai ke aap ko tarteeb pasand hai; yehi aap ko khaas banata hai!

$~Mujhe yeh bhi pasand hai ke mujhe tarteeb pasand hai! Acha, main kahan tha. Haan, teesri baat, aur yeh bhi bahut zaroori hai, KOI COMMA NAHIN! Main jaanta hoon ke kuch saqaafaton mein log fehriston mein cheezon ke darmiyan comma lagana pasand karte hain, lekin mujhe yeh pasand nahin. Yeh chhote chhote kooray ke tukron jaise hain jo meri khoobsurat tarteeb mein rukawat daalte hain, aur log inhein hamesha bhool jaate hain. Agar aap ko izhaar ki hadein dekhne mein mushkil ho rahi hai, to bas nayi line daal dein. Shayad aap in tang karne wali cheezon se chhutkara pa saken? Jitni chahein nayi lines daalein. Comma ke ilawa kuch bhi. Uff!
$~@List, mujhe aap ki sab se pasandida baton mein se ek yeh hai ke aap fehriston ko badalne mein kitne kamaal hain. Kya aap humare talib-e-ilm director ko kuch misaalein dikhana chahenge?

$~Haan, lekin @FunctionDefinition, yeh sab aap ka kamaal hai. Aap mere liye yeh sab khoobsurat function banate hain jin se main har tarah ke kaam kar sakta hoon! Jaise @List.reverse — oh, yeh bahut acha aur saada hai. Yeh meri qeematon ko ulti tarteeb mein rakh deta hai.
$~Aur yeh maze ka hai: @List.sansAll diye gaye qeemat ke barabar tamam qeematon ko hata deta hai. Dekhein, nateeje ki fehrist mein ab koi zero nahin bacha?

$~Arre, mujhe yakeen nahin aata ke main chauthe usool ko samjhana bhool gaya! Theek hai, usool number chaar: main kabhi apni list nahin badalta. Main sirf nayi lists banata hoon. Aap mujh par chahe koi bhi function chalayein, main hamesha nayi list banata hoon; kabhi purani ko nahin badalta. Toh upar wali @List.reverse ki misaal? Us ne list nahin badli; us ne nayi list banayi. Aur sans wali misaal? Us ne asli list se zero nahin hataye; us ne zero ke baghair nayi list banayi. Yeh Verse mein har cheez ke liye sach hai: jab qeematein ban jaati hain, toh woh jaisi hain waisi hi rehti hain aur badalti nahin.

$~Oh, is se mujhe aakhri usool yaad aaya, usool number paanch: main ginti 1 se shuru karta hoon! Zero se nahin, do se nahin, 1 se. Toh agar aap list mein kisi khaas jagah ki @value lena chahte hain, toh aap do aur \[]\ istemaal karke @ListAccess bana sakte hain aur woh jagah bata sakte hain jo aap chahte hain. Dekhein jab main \3\ leta hoon, toh list ki teesri qeemat deta hoon, \'c'\? Ise \1\ ya \5\ mein badal kar dekhein ke kya milta hai. Phir shayad \0\ ya \6\ bhi try karein…

$~Dilchasp hai na? Mujhe list mein ek jagah dein, aur main ghoom kar wahin pahunch jaoonga. Misaal ke taur par, \-1\ list ki aakhri cheez hai, aur agar list mein paanch cheezein hon, toh @index \6\ pehli cheez hai. Agar aap mujhe index \0\ dein, toh main aap ko @NoneLiteral dunga kyunke wahan kuch nahin hai. Samajh aaya?

$~Theek hai, shayad ek list function, kyunke yeh mera pasandida hai. Is ka naam @List.random hai aur yeh list mein se koi bhi ek @value ittifaq se deta hai. Yeh bohat mazedaar hai kyunke aap ko kabhi pata nahin hota ke kya milega! Aap ko kya mila, aap ko kya mila? Apna khud ka janwar shaamil karke dekhein ke kya milta hai.
$~List, aap bhi na! Aur bohat si acchi cheezein hain jo aap kar sakte hain; main hamesha mutaasir hota hoon. Kya aap yahan hongi agar hamare naye director dost ke koi sawal hue?
$~Haan, bilkul, hamesha! @FunctionDefinition ne mere liye bohat si dilchasp cheezein banayi hain. Bas mujhe bata dein ke aap ko kya chahiye!

lines: $~@List bohat dilchasp hain. Un ki tarteeb se mohabbat bohat pyaari aur bohat kaam ki hai! Maine socha ke ab aap ke liye un ke cousin @Set se milna dilchasp hoga, kyunke woh itne milte julte hain lekin kuch ahem baaton mein mukhtalif hain. @Set? Mere paas ek shakhs hai jis se aap ko milwana hai.
$~Oh! @FunctionDefinition! Aap hain! Aap yahan kaise? Kya khamoshi khatam ho gayi? Kya hua? Kya hum show kar rahe hain? Kya baat hai? Sab log kahan hain?

$~Itne saare sawal! Main aap ko ek aise shakhs se milwane aayi hoon jo directing karne ka soch rahe hain. Woh Verse ke baare mein sab kuch seekh rahe hain aur ummeed karte hain ke apni ilhaam hum se baantein! Hum abhi @List se baat kar rahe the, lekin pehle @Number, @Boolean, @Text, @Evaluate, aur @Program se bhi baat ki thi. Hum ab aap ke paas aaye hain kyunke hum saari collections se mil rahe hain!
$~Oh, aap se milna kitna acha hai, naye director jaise shakhs! Kya aap ke paas abhi khayal hain? Hum kya perform karenge? Kya main madad kar sakta hoon? Aap ko mujh se kya chahiye?
$~Shayad shuru mein, bas bata dein ke aap kya karte hain?

$~Oh haan, bilkul. Main cheezein jama karta hoon (Hm, zaahir hai; main ek collection hoon). Lekin sab se ahem baat yeh hai ke main har qism ki sirf *ek* cheez jama karta hoon. Aap jo chahein main jama kar sakta hoon aur qeematon ka hisaab rakhne mein madad kar sakta hoon, lekin main kabhi koi qeemat dohrata nahin. Main khud ko kuch kuch @List ki tarah sajata hoon lekin \{\ aur \}\ ke saath.
$~Yeh ek set hai. Lekin jaisa maine kaha, koi duplicate nahin. Toh agar aap mujhe yeh denge, toh main faaltu cheezein hata dunga.

$~@List ki tarah, aap @SetOrMapAccess ke saath kaam karke dekh sakte hain ke kya @value set mein maujood hai. Aap ko ya toh \⊤\ milega agar woh hai ya \⊥\ agar woh nahin hai. Dekhte hain ke kya \3\ is set se gayab hai. Haan, wahan nahin hai! \3\ ko wapas set mein daal kar dekhein.
$~@Set, kya set ki qeematon ke saath aur bhi kuch kar sakte hain aap?
$~Haan, bilkul; bohat kuch, aap ki wajah se. Aap mujhe kya karte hue dekhna chahte hain? Kya aap ke zehan mein koi performance hai? Main kaise madad kar sakta hoon? Main kya kar sakta hoon?

$~Jab yeh kisi set par chalaya jaye aur doosra set diya jaye, toh yeh diye gaye set ki saari cheezein us set se hata deta hai jis par chalaya gaya (Hm, yeh kuch ulajhe hue alfaaz the, lekin meri yahi muraad thi). Yeh ek misaal hai. Dekhein natija sirf \{3}\ ka set hai? Yehi woh ek @value hai jo \{ 1 2 }\ ki qeematein hatane ke baad bacha.
$~Aap sets mein cheezein shaamil bhi kar sakte hain aur hata bhi sakte hain. Yeh set \{1}\ leta hai, us mein \2\ shaamil karta hai, phir us mein se 1 hata deta hai, aur \{ 2 }\ bach jata hai.
$~@FunctionDefinition ki wajah se main aur bohat kuch kar sakta hoon. Jab bhi aur seekhna ho, mere paas aa jayein!
$~Oh, aur suniye @FunctionDefinition, aap ne kaha tha ke aap ne @Evaluate ko dekha?

$~Woh theek hain. Hum theek hain. Mera khayal hai... mujhe nahin pata. Shayad humein saath naachte hue bahut der ho gayi hai. Jab main unke aas paas hota hoon, mujhe lagta hai woh khud ko nahin dekhte, is liye woh mujhe bhi nahin dekhte.
$~Yeh aap ke liye bhi mushkil waqt lagta hai. Shayad hamare naye director ke saath hum phir se naachein gay, aur aap dono ko koi raasta mil jaye ga.

$~Toot rahi hai? Kya yeh kabhi sach mein khamosh thi? Aap ko dekh kar bahut acha laga, @FunctionDefinition. Arre, kya aap ne @Evaluate se baat ki? Pichli baar jab humne baat ki thi to woh theek haal mein nahin the. Aap ko unse baat karni chahiye.

$~Oh, yeh sun kar mujhe bahut afsos hua. Khamoshi ke dauran main sab se rabta mein raha aur socha ke aap aur @Evaluate ek doosre ke saath honge! Main to kisi bhi waqt baat karne ko khushi se tayyar tha. Bas main @List aur @Set ki gup shup aur @Conditional aur @BooleanLiteral ke beech ki ajeeb kashidagi ka pata rakhne mein masroof tha. Kya aap ko pata hai un ke beech kya chal raha hai?
$~Nahin, mujhe bilkul pata nahin. Kashidagi hai? Aur kaisi gup shup?
$~Jaise aap aur @Evaluate ke beech ki kashidagi?

$~Maaf kijiye. Shayad hamare mehmaan ke saamne nahin. Aap hi woh naye insaan honge jin ki sab baat kar rahe hain. Suna hai aap hamare naye director banne wale hain? Aap ke paas hamare liye kaise shandaar khayalaat hain? Gaana? Naachna? Jab tak yeh roshan, shararati aur ajeeb ho, main saath hoon!

$~Un par dabao mat daalein! Mujhe yaqeen hai ke un ke paas bahut se khayalaat hain. Hum pehla show tay karne se pehle bas seekhne aur jurne ke liye jagah bana rahe hain. Kya aap batayenge ke aap kya karte hain?

$~Main jorta hoon! Main kuch kuch lughat jaisa hoon: mujhe ek @value dein aur main aap ko us ki matabiqat wali tareef de doonga. Kya @FunctionDefinition ne aap ko qeematon ke baare mein bataya? Main unhein ek se ek, ek qeemat se doosri qeemat tak naqsha karta hoon. Mujhe ek @key dein; main aap ko us ki matabiq qeemat de doonga. Misaal ke taur par, yeh naamon se points ki ginti ka naqsha hai. Naam kunji hain; points qeemat hain.

$~Lekin @Set ki tarah, mujhe dohraav pasand nahin. Aap ek hi @key ek se zyada baar nahin rakh sakte, lekin aap jitni chahein alag alag kunjiyan barabar qeematon se jor sakte hain. Misaal ke taur par, yeh mujhe do \'ben'\ kunjiyan deta hai, lekin main sirf aakhri wali istemaal karta hoon. Lekin theek hai ke \'ben'\ aur \'joe'\ ke points barabar hain kyunke woh alag kunjiyan hain.

$~Yeh @Bind ke saath meri sajhedaari hai jo mujhe khaas banati hai! Isi se main qeematon ko doosri qeematon se jorta hoon (Kya aap @Bind se mile? Nahin? Ohhhh, aap un se pyaar karein ge. Woh SHANDAAR hain.)
$~@Map, agar aap khaali naqsha chahein to? Woh khaali majmuey \{}\ se kaise alag hai?
$~Oh, woh to bas main akela hoon! Chhota @Bind aur main bas yunhi rehte hain, na kunjiyan na qeematein.
$~Aur agar hamare director ne @value ya @key na diya to? Jaise yeh? Jaise, \3\ ki koi qeemat nahin?
$~Oh... AISA mat karna. Mujhe sirf joriyan pasand hain. Kya 3 ek @key hai? Ek @value? Bilkul uljhan wali baat. Show rok dein.
$~Aur agar hamare director ko ek @key se @value hasil karna ho to?
$~Bilkul @Set ki tarah: bas map ke baad ek \{}\ lagayein aur mujhe woh @key dein jo aap chahte hain.
$~Aur agar mere paas @key nahin hua, to main aap ko @None doon ga.
$~Agar aap @None ko kisi aur cheez ki tarah samajhna chahte hain to hamare dost @Otherwise ko istemaal karna aap ke kaam aa sakta hai.
$~Yahan, misaal ke taur par, agar koi @value na ho to hum \0points\ rakhte hain.
$~Warna main @Set se kaafi milta julta hoon: main bahut se wohi kaam kar sakta hoon. Kisi bhi waqt aaiye, mujhe aap ko aur dikha kar khushi hogi!

lines: $~Arey yaar, @FunctionDefinition, kitna arsa ho gaya! Aap to bade stylish lag rahe hain. Aajkal bohat khamoshi rehti hai, hai na? Kya aap ka koi naya dost hai?

$~Ji haan, yeh sahab director banne mein dilchaspi rakhte hain. Hum bade safar par hain — hum @Program, @ExpressionPlaceholder, @UnparsableExpression, @Evaluate aur tamam qeematon aur collections se mil chuke hain. Maine socha ke ab aap se milna behtareen rahega kyunke aap qeematon ke saath bohat qareeb se kaam karte hain.
$~Bilkul, qeematein to meri sab se achhi dost hain. Hum hafte ke akhir mein parkour karte hain — ya shows, ya jo bhi ho.
$~Haan, aap jaante hain, jaise sadkon par jimnastik, cheezon par se kood jaana, imaaraton ke beech chhalaangein lagana — jaise rassi par chalna lekin rassi ke bagair. Himmat wali chhalaangein!

$~Achha, ab samajh aaya aap ka kehna kya hai. Haan, shayad aap jo karte hain woh kuch kuch parkour jaisa hi hai. Lekin mujhe yaqeen nahin ke hamare naye director dost ko samajh aaya. Kya aap misaalon ke bagair samjha sakte hain?
$~Zaroor, bhai. To bas socho ke aap ke paas ek number hai.
$~Aur socho ke aap use matn banana chahte hain. Mujhe @Text ke saath wahan daal do aur BAM, aap ke paas matn hai!
$~Ya phir socho ke aap ke paas matn hai aur aap ko number chahiye. Mujhe @Number ke saath wahan daal do aur POP, aap ke paas number hai!

$~Lekin kya aap kuch waqai kamaal ka jaadu dekhna chahte hain? Farz karein aapke paas kuch matn hai aur aap uske huroof ek list mein chahte hain. Mujhe @List ke saath wahan daal dein aur HAAAAAA, aapke paas huroof ki ek list tayyar hai.
$~Lekin main aur @Number? Hum kuch zabardast tarkeebein seekh rahe hain. Maan lein aap ke paas din mein waqt hai aur aap ko seconds chahiye? Hum hain na.

$~Lekin asli kamaal ki tarkeeb? Zanjeer banana. Yaani kai tabdeeliyan ek ke baad ek. Yeh dekhein. Din se seconds, seconds se matn, matn se list, sab ek zanjeer mein. Ab hamare paas ankon ki list hai. Wah!
$~Toh meri baat yeh hai ke har cheez har cheez ban sakti hai, koi hadd nahin. Kuch bhi kuch bhi ban sakta hai (Matlab, kuch bhi nahin, lekin jitna mujh se ho sake).
$~Lekin kisi cheez ko ek hi pehchaan mein qaid kyun rehna chahiye, samajh rahe hain na? Azaadi, yaar.
$~Yeh kamaal hai, @Convert, aur bahut hausla badhane wali baat hai. Lekin kuch bhi, sach mein?
$~Khair, kuch bhi nahin. Matlab, agar aap mujhe seconds dein aur @Set maangein, toh iska matlab kya hoga?

$~Main poori koshish karoon ga ke koi raasta nikaaloon... jaise, yeh dekhein, mujhe aata hai ke ankon ko @Text mein aur @Text ko @Set mein kaise badlein, toh main aap ko is number ke matn mein maujood nishaanon ka set de doon ga.
$~Lekin shayad aap yeh nahin chahte the...
$~Aur agar mujhe nahin aata ke aap ki maangi hui cheez kaise doon, toh main bas sab kuch band kar doon ga.
$~Theek hai, samajh aa gaya. Yaani sirf kuch tabdeeliyan mumkin hain, saari nahin.
$~Haan… aap hamesha @type ka @value dekh sakte hain aur maaloom kar sakte hain ke woh kin tabdeeliyon ko sahaara dete hain.

$~Kya aap ko pata hai ke @Convert aur @Evaluate ek doosre se juday hue hain? Yeh cousins ki tarah hain. @Evaluate kisi bhi function ko chalata hai, lekin @Convert kisi bhi tabdeeli ko chalata hai. Ek tarah se @Evaluate bhi tabdeeli karta hai, input se output mein.

$~Wah. Maine kabhi aise nahin socha tha. Matlab, /main/ input ko output mein badalta hoon, aur @Evaluate bhi input ko output mein badalta hai. Aur @FunctionDefinition, aap *hamein batate hain* ke input ko output mein kaise badlein. Kya yahi Verse ka raaz hai?
$~Ke har cheez input ko output mein badalne ke baare mein hai?
$~@Convert, hamare naye director ko kaise pata chale ke kaun si tabdeeliyan mumkin hain?
$~Maaf karna yaar, main abhi tak thora hila hua hoon. Ummm, woh rehnuma @UI/docsExpand mein @value ki kisi bhi qism ko dekh sakte hain.
$~Wahan un doosri qismon ki list honi chahiye jin mein main unhein badal sakta hoon… Har cheez tabdeeli hai…
$~Aap se mil kar bahut acha laga, @Convert! Hum ab doosron se milne jaa rahe hain. Jaldi milte hain?

scenes.title: $~Kaise chunein?
scenes.subtitle: $~Faisle
lines: $~Ab tak ke safar mein hum @values ki bahut si qismon se mile hain aur un ke saath kaam karne ke bahut se tareeqon par baat ki hai. Bas ek aur hai jis se main aap ka taaruf karwana chahta tha. Yeh khaas is liye hain ke inhi ki wajah se hamare muzahire itne harkat bhare hote hain. Inhein @Conditional kehte hain, aur yeh Verse ka woh markazi kirdaar hain jo *faislay* karta hai.

$~Saaf kar doon, saare faislay nahin: meri apni zindagi hai, aur un ki apni. Lekin muzahire mein, jab hum stage par agla kaam tay kar rahe hote hain, toh director ke taur par aap ki rehnumai par chalna aur faisla karna un ka kaam hai. Toh yeh ek @key saathi hain jo dilchasp muzahire banate hain.
$~@Conditional, khamoshi toot rahi hai! Shayad hum phir se shows karein!
$~@FunctionDefinition? Khamoshi toot rahi hai? Khamoshi kya hoti hai? Isse kaise toorte hain? Kya hum kabhi sach mein khamosh hote hain? Yeh kaun hai? Kya yehi isse tor rahe hain?

$~Haan, khamoshi toot rahi hai, aur yehi woh hain! Yeh ek insaan hain, aur woh hamein himmat dene aur hamare shows ki rehnumai karne aaye hain. Hum tabdeeliyon aur tamam qeematon se milne ki baat kar rahe the, aur @Text aur @Convert aur main chahta tha ke woh aap se milein! Ek tarah se, aap tabdeeliyon mein sab se khaas hain kyunki aap hamein haalaat ko nayi qeematon mein badalne dete hain.
$~Main faisle zaroor karta hoon, lekin asal mein main woh faisle likhta hoon jo director mujhe karne ko kehte hain, to kya waqai main faisle kar raha hoon?
$~Mere khayal mein haan. Yeh zyada aisa hai ke director faisla likhta hai aur phir aap ko saunp deta hai. Aap faisla karne wale ban jaate hain. Kya aap ek misaal dikhana chahenge?

$~Kya aap dekhte hain ke @Conditional ke andaaz mein chaar hisse hain? Sab se pehle ek *@condition* hai, jo ek @Boolean hona chahiye. Phir \?\ hai. Phir *haan* @expression hai, aur phir ek *nahin* izhaar. @Conditional yeh karta hai ke shart ko jaanchta hai, aur agar woh \⊤\ ho, to *haan* wala izhaar chalata hai. Warna woh /nahin/ wala izhaar chalata hai. Faisla karne ka yeh kitna zabardast tareeqa hai!
$~Kya aap hamein ek aur khaas misaal de sakte hain?
$~Umm, hm. Main maan leta hoon ke yeh ek faisla hai, lekin ghalat hai. Ek paanch se chhota nahin hota. Shayad aap ke faisle hamesha sahi nahin hote, lekin bharose ke qaabil to hain, hai na?

$~Bharose ke qaabil? Shayad? Agar aap maan lein ke main bas wohi faisla karta hoon jo director mujhe batata hai, to haan, lekin agar director mujhe yeh bataye to? Kya yeh waqai faisla hai agar number kabhi \3\ se bara ho hi nahin sakta?

$~Hm, yeh to theek baat hai. Shayad koi cheez faisla hai ya nahin, yeh bohat had tak is par hai ke director ka faisla kya hai. To iska matlab hai ke director ko un faislon ke baare mein bohat ghaur se sochna hoga jo woh aap ko deta hai?

$~Ghaur se? Shak ke saath, shayad? Kya aap ne mere achhe doston @BooleanLiteral ke baare mein socha hai? Un ka duniya ko dekhne ka nazariya un tamam faislon ko dikhane ke liye kaise kaafi ho sakta hai jo hum karna chahein? Maslan agar hum aisa performance chahein jo kisi ka naam le aur faisla kare ke woh khoobsurat hai ya nahin? Kya yeh sach ya jhoot wala faisla hai? Kya yeh aisa faisla bhi hai jo hamein karna chahiye? Kya yeh bohat hi tang aur ek tarfa nahin lagta?
$~Director, aap ke khayal mein kaun se huroof naam ko khoobsurat banate hain?

$~Aur un sawalon ke baare mein sochein jin ka main jawab deta hoon — main sirf \⊤\ aur \⊥\ ka jawab kyun de sakta hoon? Number ka kyun nahin? Kya mujhe yeh faisla karne ka haq nahin ke \1\ khoobsurat hai?

$~Main ne kabhi is tarah socha hi nahin tha. Lekin @Conditional, chahe aap ki kuch hadein hain, aap khoobsurat hain. Aap hamein hamare performances mein itna kuch karne dete hain jo hum warna nahin kar sakte. Aap bohat khushi aur hansi mumkin banate hain. Hamare director ne to abhi tak woh hairat angez cheezein dekhi hi nahin jo aap kar sakte hain.
$~Ke main khoobsurat hoon? Shayad yeh hadein phir bhi qeemti hain?
$~Aur main apne naye dost ko dikhane ke liye josh mein hoon ke woh kitni qeemti hain. Kya jab main yeh karoon to aap yahan honge?
$~Kya koi cheez mujhe is se zyada khush kar sakti hai?

scenes.title: $~Input
lines: $~Kya aap jaante the ke aap ki duniya aur hamari duniya aapas mein jurri hui hain? Kuch aawaaz nikaalein aur hum use sun sakte hain...
$~Aap ko nahin pata tha ke Verse maujood hai, lekin hum jaante hain ke aap ka maujood hai. Kyunki aap ki duniya hi hamari duniya ko dilchasp banati hai.
$~Aap ne shayad yeh dekha hoga jab hum ghoomte hue tamam qeematon, majmooon aur baatcheet se mile.
$~In qeematon ka /matlab/ kya hai agar koi shakhs unhein matlab /dene/ wala ya unhein pehle jagah par dene wala hi na ho?

$~Main aap ko hamari duniyaon ke darmiyan ka rishta dikhana chahta hoon aur yeh bhi ke woh kya mumkin banate hain. Hum unhein *input @streams* kehte hain, aur yeh shayad Verse ka sab se jaadooi input hain. Yeh un functions jaise hain jo ek khaas qism ka @value banate hain jo aap ki duniya ke badalne ke saath badalta hai. Yeh un tareeqon se baat bhi nahin kar sakte jin ke aap aadi hon. Yeh kisi doosri duniya ki dhadkan jaise hain. Is liye main poori koshish karoonga ke aap ko samjhaoon ke yeh kaise kaam karte hain, kyunki yeh khud nahin samjha sakte.
$~Kya aap in mein se kisi se milne ke liye tayyar hain?

scenes.title: $~Tik, tik, tik...
scenes.subtitle: $~Waqt
lines: $~Chaliye sab se buniyadi @stream se aaghaz karte hain: @Time. Dhaara banane ke liye hum @Evaluate istemaal karte hain aur us dhaare ki @type ka naam dete hain jo aap chahte hain.

$~Stage ke upar mode switcher @UI/modeSwitcher mein ▶️ play button dabayein aur waqt ko chalte dekhein. Kya aap dekh rahe hain ke waqt kaise badal raha hai? Dhaare @values ka ek silsila hote hain. Jab bhi dhaare ko nayi qeemat milti hai, @Program nayi dhaara qeemat ke saath dobara hisaab lagata hai. Isi liye yeh program ginta hi rehta hai: humne ek waqt ka dhaara banaya jo 0 milli second se shuru hota hai aur har baar ghadi ke tik karne par badalta rehta hai. Yeh waqt aap ka waqt hai, aap ki duniya se. Jab aap @code badalna chahein, to wapas ✏️ edit mode mein jayein; edit karte waqt stage maujooda lamhe par ruka rehta hai.

$~Woh \1000ms\ dekha? Yeh ek @Time.frequency hai jo @Time ko batata hai ke har 1000 milli second par tik kare, na ke har 33 milli second par jo us ka tay shuda hai. Ab yeh ek aise ginti karne wale ki tarah hai jo har second tik karta hai. Yeh inputs jo @Time leta hai ek tarah ki tarteeb hain: yeh dhaare ko batate hain ke kaise barta-o karna hai.

$~Lekin hum un tamam shandaar kirdaron ko istemaal kar ke waqt ko aur badal sakte hain jin se hum mile hain. Misaal ke taur par, agar hum jaanna chahein ke waqt \2\ ka guna hai ya nahin? Hum @Number.remainder istemaal kar sakte hain, jo taqseem ka baqi nikalta hai. Agar baqi sifar ho, to hum \⊤\ nikalenge, warna \⊥\. ▶️ play dabayein aur dekhein ke yeh \⊤\ aur \⊥\ ke darmiyan kaise badalta hai? Yeh kitna jaadooi hai.

$~Ek aur cheez dhoondhne ki hai: output ke neeche ka timeline har us baar ko record karta hai jab program ne dobara hisaab lagaya, yaani har us baar jab koi dhaara badla — yahan, har baar jab @Time ne tik kiya. Mode switcher @UI/modeSwitcher mein ⏸️ debug button dabayein taake ise qareeb se dekh saken, har @expression ki qeemat us ke saath dikhai jayegi.

$~Timeline @UI/timeline aap ko un hisaabon mein peeche jaane deta hai, taake aap dekh saken ke @Evaluate un izhaaron ko ek ek qadam kar ke kaise hal karta hai jo aap ne seekhe hain, yahan tak ke woh us qeemat tak pahunchta hai jo @Program @stage par dikhata hai. ⏸️ debug mein rahein — timeline yahin hai — aur hum mein se koi aap ko dikhayega ke us ke tamam control kahan hain. Phir khoj karein; jab aap kar lein, to mode switcher @UI/modeSwitcher aap ko wapas ▶️ playing ya ✏️ editing mein le jata hai. @Tour/stage

$~@Time ek dilchasp dhaara hai kyunki isay kai alag cheezon ke liye istemaal kiya ja sakta hai: yeh gin sakta hai ke koi performance kitni der se ho rahi hai, kisi waqiye ka waqt naap sakta hai, ya kisi lafz ko harkat de sakta hai. Yeh sab se lachakdaar dhaaron mein se hai lekin sab se tajreedi mein se bhi.

lines: $~Agar main ghalat nahin hoon, to aap ki duniya mein ek cheez hai jise “keyboard” kehte hain? Yeh is tarah ka zariya hai jis se aap chunte hain ke hum mein se kaun aap ke documents mein aaye, theek? Verse mein, hum yeh darkhwaastein ek matn ki @stream ki shakal mein wasool karte hain, har matn @value us @key ko zaahir karta hai jo dabayi gayi. Hum inhein istemaal karte hain yeh sunne ke liye ke aap ki duniya ke log kya type kar rahe hain. Is dhaare ko @Key kehte hain.

$~Yeh ek saada misaal hai. Stage par click karein ya keyboard se us par focus karein aur phir koi bhi keyboard kunji dabayein. Aap dekhenge ke jo kunji aap ne dabayi woh apne naam ke saath nazar aati hai. Is ki wajah yeh hai ke jab bhi kunji ka dhaara badalta hai, @Program kunji ke dhaare ko us ki taaza tareen qeemat ke taur par parhta hai aur phir use stage par dikhata hai.

$~Yeh dhaara us waqt badalti hai jab bhi koi kunji dabayi jaye. Lekin aap kisi dhaare ko bata sakte hain ke woh sirf ek khaas kunji dabne par badle. Dekhein, dhaara pehli baar \a\ mein badalta hai, magar uske baad nahin badalta. Yeh isliye ke yeh dhaara sirf tab badalta hai jab \a\ dabayi jaye, is liye hamesha \a\ dikhata hai. Lekin timeline mein aapko nayi kunji ki qeemat hamesha nazar aayegi.

$~Kabhi kabhi yeh jaanna kaam aata hai ke kunji kab chhodi gayi, na ke kab dabayi gayi. \⊥\ dein taa ke @Key dhaara jaan le ke aap kunji chhodne ka waqt jaanna chahte hain. Ab 'a' kunji ko dabaye rakhein, aur jab chhodein to stage par 'a' nazar aayega. Nazar nahin aaya? ↻ button dabayein, performance dobara shuru karein aur phir koshish karein.

$~@Key dhaare tab bohat madadgaar hote hain jab aap chahte hain ke performance un kunjiyon par jawab de jo dekhne wale dabate hain. Misaal ke taur par, aap dekh sakte hain ke kunji mein lafz 'Arrow' hai ya nahin, taa ke pata chale ke teer wali kunji dabayi gayi. Koi teer wali kunji dabayein to \'hilein'\ nazar aayega; kuch aur dabayein to \'rukein'\ nazar aayega.

scenes.title: $~Kya koi sun raha hai?
scenes.subtitle: $~Hajm
lines: $~Aapki duniya aur hamari duniya mein awaaz bhi hai. Kya aap jaante hain ke hum aapki ijazat se aapko sun sakte hain? Hum @stream se sunte hain jiska naam @Volume hai, jo awaaz ki shiddat ka ek buniyadi silsila deta hai. Aapka mic aapse hamare saath share karne ki ijazat maang sakta hai. Jab aap ijazat de denge, to aapko ek number nazar aayega jo awaaz ki shiddat batata hai, \0\ aur \100\ ke darmiyan.

$~@Volume se performance ko dekhne walon ki awaaz par jawab dene wala banaya ja sakta hai. Misaal ke taur par, yahan hum dhaare ke amplitude number ko ek khaas tadaad ke \'ya'\ harf mein badal kar amplitude ki chhoti si tasveer bana sakte hain. Dekhein, jab aap shor karte hain to \'ya'\ zyada ho jate hain? @Volume amplitude ko \10\ se taqseem kiya jata hai, jis se woh \0\ se \10\ ke daayre mein aa jata hai. Phir woh @value @Text.repeat function ko diya jata hai, jo \'ya'\ ko diye gaye number ke barabar dohrata hai.

lines: $~Ek aur zariya hai jo main aapko dikhana chahta hoon. Yaad hai pehle \[].random()\, @List se?

$~Andar se yeh @Random naam ki ek @FunctionDefinition istemaal karta hai, jo ittifaqi adaad ka ek be-intiha silsila deta hai. Yeh ek tarah ki dhaara hai kyunke yeh aapki duniya se input banata hai, hamari duniya se nahin. Lekin yeh baqi @streams se thoda mukhtalif hai, kyunke yeh @Program ko dobara chalne par majboor nahin karta.
$~Iske bajaye, jab bhi isay chalaya jata hai, yeh ek alag ittifaqi adad deta hai.

$~Stage ke toolbar mein (aur timeline par bhi) woh chhota sa ↻ @UI/resetEvaluator button dekha? Isay dabayein taake program haath se dobara chale, aur aap har baar \0\ aur \1\ ke darmiyan ek naya adad dekhenge.
$~Hum @Random ko adaad ka daayra bata sakte hain, kam se kam aur ziyada se ziyada adad de kar. Yeh misaal \1\ aur \10\ ke darmiyan adaad deti hai:

$~Ittifaqi kitna maza ka hai! Hum isay dhaaron ke saath istemaal kar ke mazedaar afra-tafri bana sakte hain. Misaal ke taur par, yahan hum alfaaz ki ek fehrist mein se ek ittifaqi lafz chunte hain. Yeh \['billi' 'cat' 'billi jaisa'].random()\ jaisa hi hai. ↻ dabate rahein taake billi ka ek aur hum-maani lafz mile! Fehrist mein apna lafz daal kar dekhein, kya woh nazar aata hai?

lines: $~Ab tak jin *@streams* ki humne baat ki, woh sab saade @values ke silsile hain, jaise @Text ya @Number. Lekin kuch dhaare pechida qeematein bhi bana sakte hain.

lines: $~Yeh saare @streams jo maine aap ko dikhaye, aap ki duniya se aate hain. Lekin kabhi kabhi in dhaaron ke aadhar par apni dhaarein banana madadgaar hota hai. Wahan mera dost @Reaction kaam aata hai! @Reaction, kya aap yahan hain?
$~Haan haan haan! Main @FunctionDefinition hoon! Aap kaise hain? Aajkal sab kuch bohat… yaksaan raha hai. Kya aap ne yeh dekha hai?
$~Aap khamoshi ki baat kar rahe hain? Haan, kuch bhi nahin badla, hai na, jab se aakhri shakhs gaya hai? Aap ke liye yeh kaisa raha?

$~Bohat ajeeb, bohat ajeeb. Meri poori zindagi tabdeeli ke baare mein rahi hai, hamesha logon ke naye inputs sunna aur dekhna, aur unhein qeematon mein badalne mein madad karna. Lekin kuch bhi nahin aaya. Bas abhi ek lamha pehle tak… Ruko… kya yeh koi shakhs hai?

$~Haan! Yeh hamare naye mumkina director hain. Main abhi unhein @Time, @Key, @Pointer, @Button, @Volume, aur @Random dikha raha tha, to aap ne zaroor un ke saare naye inputs dekhe honge jo woh apni duniya se la rahe the.
$~Haaaan, tabdeeli aa rahi hai! Kya main aap ko dikhaoon ke main kya karta hoon?
$~Theek hai, to mujhe aap se teen cheezein chahiye: tabdeeli ke liye ek @condition, ek ibtidai @value, aur ek agli qeemat.
$~*Ibtidai* qeemat woh qeemat hai jo main kisi bhi tabdeeli se pehle banaoon. Yeh kisi bhi qism ki aam @expression hoti hai!
$~Phir ibtidai qeemat ke baad \…\ lagayein taake main jaan sakoon ke qeemat badal sakti hai.

$~\…\ ke baad mujhe ek *shart* dein jo \⊤\ ya \⊥\ banti ho. Aam taur par woh ek ya zyada dhaaron ko jaanche — warna kuch bhi nahin badal raha, kyunke performance mein tabdeeli ka sirf ek zariya dhaarein hain.
$~Phir shart ke baad ek aur \…\ lagayein taake main jaan sakoon ke qeemat badal sakti hai.
$~Aakhir mein, *agli* qeemat woh qeemat hai jo main har us waqt banaoon jab shart badalti hai.

$~Yeh ek misaal hai. @Key dhaara dekhein? Us se pehle ∆ lagane ka matlab hai, /Kya yeh dhaara badli?/ Badalne se pehle main ibtidai qeemat \1m\ ban jata hoon. Lekin jab space kunji dabai jaati hai, to @Program dobara chalti hai, aur main *agli* @expression ban jata hoon, jo \1m\ aur dhaare ki pichhli qeemat ka jama hai; woh \.\ se dikhai jaati hai. Yeh jumle ke size mein \1m\ jodta hai, jis se lafz bada hota jata hai.
$~@Reaction, yeh bohat zabardast hai. Kya aap @Changed ka taaruf karwana chahenge? Aisa lagta hai aap un ke saath qareeb se kaam karte hain.
$~Haan, @Changed aur main sab se achhe dost hain! Woh mujhe batate hain ke kab kuch badla hai. Woh dhaaron ke sargoshi karne wale jaise hain, director ki duniya ko dhyaan se sunte hue…
$~Wah, dhaaron ka sargoshi karne wala, yeh kuch zyada lagta hai...
$~Oh, hi, @Changed! Kya aap bata sakte hain ke aap kya karte hain?
$~Main bas yeh batata hoon ke dhaara badli ya nahin. Aap mujhe dhaara dein, main check kar loonga. Bas yehi.
$~Lekin yeh to us se zyada hai, hai na?
$~Nahin, aisa nahin. Bas yehi mera kaam hai. Main isme achha hoon, lekin mera sirf yehi ek kaam hai.

$~Theek hai. Lekin mere khayal mein aap is se zyada ahem hain. Kyunke main aap ke bina bilkul bekaar hoon! Misaal ke taur par, agar aap mujhe aisa @condition dein jo dhaara ko check nahin karta, to main kabhi naya qeemat nahin banaunga. Jaise yahan, shart @Boolean @Button se hai, lekin aap ke bina main sirf button se hi badalta hoon.
$~Oh, yeh samajh mein aata hai. Aur @Reaction, kya aap har dhaara ke saath kaam karte hain?

$~Ji haan, har dhaara ke saath! Aur asal mein apne saath bhi. To agar aap ek radd-e-amal banayein aur chahein ke ek aur radd-e-amal us radd-e-amal par radd-e-amal de, to aap yeh bhi kar sakte hain. Lekin abhi is ki fikr nahin karte, kyunke aam saadah numaishon mein yeh aksar nahin aata.
$~Shukriya, @Reaction. Kya aap madad ke liye maujood rahenge jab main apne director ko apni khoobsurat Verse ka baaqi hissa dikhaunga?
$~Ji haan, zaroor, kisi bhi waqt. Main aap ke khayalat dekhne ke liye bekaraar hoon!!

scenes.title: $~Nateeja
lines: $~To ab tak aap ka kya khayal hai? Mujhe lagta hai Verse bahut umda hai, zyadatar is liye ke is ke kirdar bahut umda hain. Har koi bahut khaas hai!
$~Aap bore ho rahe hain? Arre. Main to samajh raha tha ke yeh sab bahut dilchasp hoga! Aap kya dekhne ki ummeed kar rahe the?

$~Main samajh gaya. Matn, adaad, fehristein aur @streams boring lagte hain. Shayad maine aap ko woh sab cheezein dikhayi hi nahin jo hum in sab se bana sakte hain. Shayad ab waqt hai ke hum nateeje ke baare mein baat shuru karein.

$~Aap pehle hi bahut sa nateeja dekh chuke hain. Har baar jab @Program chalta hai, to @value banta hai aur @Program us qeemat ko stage par dikhata hai. Lekin ab tak aap ne sirf adaad, matn, fehristein jaisi cheezein dekhi hain. Main samajhta hoon, aap poori numaishein dekhna chahte hain, bilkul hamari tarah!

$~Yaad hai woh nateeja jo maine aap ko bahut pehle dikhaya tha, @Phrase? Wahin se numaishein asal mein shuru hoti hain. Chalein wahin se shuru karte hain! Phir main aap ko dikhaunga ke is buniyaadi hisse se aur bhi dilchasp numaishein kaise banayi jaati hain. Chalein, main aap ka taaruf karwata hoon!

lines: $~Main bilkul khush hoon meri jaan; aap kaise hain? Aap aaj bohat shaandaar lag rahe hain! Mujhe bohat pasand aayega ke kisi din aap ko stage par laaun.
$~Oh, stage mere liye nahin hai; main stage ke peechhe rehkar set ko theek karne mein hi bohat khush hoon.

$~Sharmayein nahin; aap bhi mere jitne hi kamaal hain. Aap ko bas thoda sa rang, ek achha font chahiye, aur aap lajawaab lagenge. Aap ke paas dikhane ko bohat kuchh hai! Is baat par, humne bohat arse se koi show nahin kiya, hai na? Kya sab khaamosh raha hai? Aap jaante hain main khud se kitni baatein karta hoon; mujhe kabhi pata hi nahin chalta.

$~Sab khaamosh raha hai. Jab se hamare pichhle director gaye hain, sab khaali khaali hai. Lekin ab yeh badal raha hai! Hamare paas ek naya shakhs hai! Hum poore khandaan se mil rahe hain: @Program, @ExpressionPlaceholder, @Evaluate, saare @values, saari collections. Humne abhi saare @streams ke saath bhi waqt guzaara, aur @Reaction aur @Conditional ke saath bhi. Mujhe kuchh kuchh mehsoos hone laga hai, hmm. Lekin maine apne naye director ko abhi tak yeh nahin bataya ke aap stage par kya karte hain? Yeh aap ki duniya hai, meri nahin; maine socha pehle aap ke paas aate hain.

$~Aap bilkul sahi jagah aaye hain. Mujhe stage ki zindagi ki har baat karna pasand hai. Main intezaar nahin kar sakta ke aap ko woh saari pyaari chhoti chhoti cheezein dikhaun jo hum yahan stage par karte hain!
$~To mujhe pata hai aap ne mujhe yeh karte dekha hai.

$~Meri jaan, stage par ek lafz laane ka yeh sab se aasaan tareeqa hai. Lekin is se bohat zyada kuchh hai! Misaal ke taur par, kya aap jaante hain ke aap @FormattedTranslation ke saath kaam kar ke apne matn ko saja sakte hain? Aap un se abhi nahin mile, lekin bas apne matn ke aas paas khaas nishaan lagane hain. Dekhiye: moota!
$~Kya yeh kaafi shokh nahin? To underline, italics, halka matn, aur bohat moota matn *sab ek saath* kaisa rahega?

$~Aur agar aap in khaas formatting ke nishaanon ko saja kar nahin balki matn ki tarah istemaal karna chahein, to bas unhein dohra dein, jaise @Text mein, aur main us nishaan ko seedha seedha likh dunga.
$~Lekin main sirf matn ko saja hi nahin sakta. Misaal ke taur par, main meters mein naapa hua ek @Phrase.size le sakta hoon \m\. Size ko apni pasand ke kisi bhi size mein badal kar dekhein!

$~Yeh size koi bhi @expression ho sakta hai. Misaal ke taur par, farz karein hum chahte hain ke yeh @Time ke tick karne ke saath badhe. Hum waqt lete hain, use meter ke ek hisse se guna karte hain, aur shaandaar, tick tick tick, hi hi hi. Frequency ya multiplier badal kar dekhein. Dekhein aap kitni khoobsurat badhat bana sakte hain!
$~Kya aap ko costumes pasand hain? Mujhe costumes bohat hi pasand hain. Mera @Phrase.face ek costume hai. Apne chune hue lafz ko sajaane ke liye koi bhi supported face chunein.

$~Kya aap chahte hain ke main stage par kisi aur jagah jaun? Apni apni jagah lein! Ek @Place sirf ek \x\, \y\, aur chunav ke taur par \z\ position hai meters mein \m\. Numbers badal kar ya stage par @Phrase ko ghaseet kar jagah ko kisi aur maqam par badal kar dekhein.
$~Kya aap kabhi thoda sa tirchha mehsoos karte hain? Shayad aap rotation ke saath duniya ko thoda sa @Pose.rotation dete hain. Mujhe ghumaane ke liye rotation ki qeemat badal kar dekhein!
$~Ya shayad hum thodi mazaa karein aur rotation ko @Time se jodein! Waah waah. Koi andaza ke mujhe tez kaise ghumaya jaye? Dekhein kya aap pata laga sakte hain…
$~Yeh yaad dilane ka behtareen waqt hai ke yahan @FunctionDefinition ko inputs ek khaas tarteeb mein chahiye, to agar aap unhein be-tarteeb rakhenge, to woh. Shikayat. Karenge.

$~Mujhe… cheezein… saaf suthri pasand hain… Kya aap unhein sahi tarteeb mein rakh sakte hain? Aap keyboard se cut aur paste kar sakte hain ya izhaar ko click kar ke ghaseet kar unhein dobara tarteeb de sakte hain.
$~Sirf ek khaas @property dena chahte hain? Bas jo chahiye uska naam likhein. Yahan hum @Phrase.size aur @Phrase.rotation ka naam likhte hain.

$~Ab jab yeh sab ho chuka, hum naachne ki baat kar sakte hain, meri jaan! Naachna mere pasandida kaamon mein se ek hai. Main *chaar* tareeqon se harkat karta hoon. Pehle, main @Phrase.entering kar sakta hoon. Enter stage mein dakhil hone ka mera tareeqa hai. Agar aap mujhe nahin batayenge ke kaise dakhil hona hai, to main bas BLIP stage par aise zaahir ho jaunga jaise wahan teleport ho gaya hoon. Lekin agar aap mujhe @Pose denge, to main aap ke diye hue pose se shuru karunga, phir apne aaraam ke pose mein aa jaunga. Misaal ke taur par, mujhe nazar na aane se aap ke saamne saaf nazar aane tak dheere dheere ubharne dein.

$~Nazar nahin aaya? Kya main bohat tez chala gaya? Is liye ke meri duration pehle se \0s\ hai. Mujhe duration se dheema karein, jo mujhe batati hai ke mujhe poses ke darmiyan harkat karne mein kitna waqt lena hai. Maine ise aap ke liye achha aur dheema rakha hai, lekin duration ko zyada aur kam numbers mein badal kar dekhein.

$~Ab maan lein main hilne wala hoon. Hum meri jagah ko waqt se jod denge, to main har second thoda sa daayein taraf jaaunga. Lekin agar hum @Phrase.moving @Pose lagayein aur @Pose.rotation \5°\ rakhein, aur shayad thoda sa rang bhi, to jab bhi meri jagah badlegi, main stage par sab se pyaare se jhukaao ke saath phislunga.

lines: $~Aap ne shayad dekha hoga ke main @Program mein thodi si jagah gher leta hoon. Agar aap mujhe parhne mein aasaan banana chahte hain, to meri khaasiyaat ke beech kuch lines daal dein. Dekhein, ab kitna aasaan dikhta hai?

$~Wah wah, yeh bahut hi shaandaar tha, @Phrase! Main hamesha hairaan reh jaata hoon ke sirf chand saadah khayalon se aap kitna kuch kar lete hain. Kuch der pehle main ne apne naye hausla badhane wale dost ko palette ke baare mein bataya tha. Kya aap is ke baare mein kuch aur kehna chahenge?

$~Zaroor! Jab bhi aap @Evaluate ke inputs se tang aa jaayein, to aap stage par koi phrase chun sakte hain, aur ek palette zaahir hoga, jis se aap har chhoti cheez badal sakte hain: meri size, font, jagah, poses. Bas ek usool hai: agar aap in mein se kisi ko sirf qeemat ke bajaye ek @expression bana dein, to aap ko use palette mein nahin, balke @Program mein badalna hoga. Mujhe jaise chahein sajaayein!

$~Haaye haaye haaye, mujhe yaqeen nahin aata ke main rang ko bhool gaya. Acha, to har @Pose ka ek rang ho sakta hai, theek hai? Lekin @Color teen hisson mein aata hai. Pehla, 0 aur 100% ke beech ek @Color.lightness, jise aap yun samajh sakte hain jaise kamre mein kitni roshni hai, kaale se safed tak, aur 50% par rang beech mein hota hai.
$~Phir, 0 aur ∞ ke beech ek @Color.chroma, jise aap yun samajh sakte hain ke rang kitna gehra hai, be-rang slati se le kar poore rang tak.

$~Aur aakhir mein, ek @Color.hue, jise aap rang ke pahiye ki tarah samajh sakte hain, laal se hara aur neela, degree mein. To aap chahte hain main chamakdar laal ho jaaun? Meri aaraam wali pose ka rang \Color(50% 300 30°)\ par set kar dein.
$~Aur chahte hain main qaus-e-quzah ke saath jhilmilaun? Waqt lein, use 360 se taqseem karke baqi nikaalein, phir degrees se zarb dein, aur main poora din us rang ke pahiye par ghoomta rahunga!
$~@Phrase, yeh to fakhr ki baat hai :P Mera khayal hai hum agle @Sequence ko dekhne jaayenge aur phir shayad @Group aur @Stage ko. Kya aap madad ke liye mojood honge?
$~Main to yeh kabhi na chhodun. Chamakte rahein!

lines: $~@Phrase bahut hi kamaal hain, hai na? Un mein kitni taaqat hai, kitne zabardast andaaz hain. Kya aap jaante hain ke woh hamare raqs ke rehnuma @Sequence ke saath mil kar kaam karte hain? @Sequence aur @Phrase mil kar kuch aise ajeeb kaam kar sakte hain jo @Phrase akela nahin kar sakta. Kya aap un se milna chahenge?
$~Wah! @Sequence, hamare paas ek mehmaan hai. Kya aap wahan peeche hain?

$~@FunctionDefinition! Aap bahut khoobsurat lag rahe hain. Kitna arsa ho gaya? Ek hafta? Ek mahina? Ek sadi? Bas 1, 2, 3 hua aur phir sab kuch khamosh ho gaya. Mujhe lagta hai main hamesha se akela naach raha hoon…

$~Sab khamosh tha, hai na? Lekin main aap ko akele naachte hue bilkul dekh sakta hoon. Main bhi akela apna raqs bana raha tha, bas yeh sochna parta tha ke aap sab mil kar kaam kar rahe hain. Lekin woh baat nahin thi.
$~Aur aap aur @Evaluate? Kya aap abhi bhi…
$~Main ne unhein abhi kuch der pehle dekha. Woh… Arre, hamare paas mehmaan hai! @Sequence, yeh hamare naye director dost hain. Woh hamein hausla dene aaye hain!
$~(Hum us chai ki baat par wapas aayenge, @FunctionDefinition). Director dost, aap se mil kar bahut khushi hui! Kya aap yahan naachna seekhne aaye hain?
$~Zaroor aaye hain! Kya aap unhein qadam dikhana chahenge?

$~Bilkul. Aap waqt ko jaante hain? 1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 3, 4? Main waqt ko khoobsurat banata hoon, @Phrase ke peechhe chalne ke liye waqt ke saath poses ka ek silsila lagata hoon. Aap mujhe batayein ke poses kya hain, aur main @Phrase ko qadmon par chalne mein madad karunga.
