lines: $~Yeh meri kaam karne ki aik aasaan misaal hai. Yeh @Phrase hai (hi, @Phrase!) jis par lafz “dance” likha hai, aur unka enter pose @Sequence hai, na ke sirf aik @Pose. Samajh aa raha hai? Is sequence ke chaar qadam hain. Seedha, baayen jhukna, daayen jhukna, seedha. Jab @Phrase aate hain, woh yeh pyaara sa hilna karte hain aur phir ruk jaate hain. Main @MapLiteral ke saath kaam karta hoon taake fisad ko @Pose se jod sakoon. Har fisad batata hai ke sequence mein har @Pose kitni dair baad hona chahiye. Fisad badal kar dekhein, khaas taur par beech ke do. Isse hilne ka bahao aur andaaz badal jaata hai.

$~Ab sochein ke aap ise bohat tez karna chahte hain. Aam taur par main kaafi tez hoon, is liye koi bhi sequence aik chauthai second mein khatam ho jaata hai. Lekin agar aap ise aur tez chahein? Mujhe chhoti muddat dein, aur main har @Pose ko tez kar doonga taake kaam jaldi ho. 1, 2, 3, 4! Ab yeh hilna nahin lagta, hai na? Yeh to bechain si larzish lagti hai! Dekhein jab aap mujhe 2 ya 3 second tak sust kar dein to kaisa lagta hai…

$~Lekin kabhi kabhi hamein koi pyaari harkat soojhti hai, aur hum use zor dene ke liye baar baar karna chahte hain! Yeh thoda zyada tez lag raha hai… meri muddat aur ginti badal kar dekhein jab tak bilkul theek na ho jaye…

$~Lekin aap kahenge, agar hum ise hamesha ke liye karna chahein? Aap mujhe aik @Phrase.resting de sakte hain. Jab tak @Phrase stage par hai aur aaraam ki @state mein hai, woh sequence dohrata rahega. Be-intiha hilna!

$~@Sequence, yeh bohat kamaal hai! Mein bilkul yahi chahta tha ke aap hamein dikhayein. Lekin mujhe jaanne ka shauq hai, aap aajkal kis cheez par kaam kar rahe hain, apne khud ke dance? Shayad kuch aisa jo aap ki saari salahiyat dikhaye?
$~Ji haan! @Phrase aur mein is naye donut dance par kaam kar rahe hain. Isme meri pasandeeda meethi cheez aur dance mein seekhi hui lagbhag har cheez shaamil hai. Kya aap dekhna chahte hain?
$~Yeah, hmm, oooh, up, eee, eee, eee, eee, bam, boo, yeah, hmm, oooh, up, eee, eee, eee, eee, bam, boo, yeah, hmm, oooh, up, eee, eee, eee, eee, bam, boo, …
$~@Sequence, yeh kamaal hai! Yeh agla mashhoor dance kyun nahin ban sakta?
$~Aap ka matlab agla ghoomta hua dance. Shukriya!

lines: $~Aah… sab log @Evaluate ka zikr karte rehte hain, lekin mujhe samajh nahin aata ke kya kahoon. Kya kabhi aap kisi ke bohat qareeb hote hain aur phir bhi bohat door?
$~Maaf kijiye. Mujhe aap ke saath yahan hone ki khushi hai.
$~Mera khayal hai ke theek yeh hoga ke mein aap ko baaqi sab se milwaoon, phir hum aik show karein, aur phir @Evaluate aur mein baatein suljha lein ge.
$~Oh, @Group! Mujhe yaqeen nahin aata ke mein @Group ko bhool gaya.
$~Yeh bilkul theek waqt hai; aap ab @Phrase aur @Sequence ko jaante hain, aur @Group hum sab ko jodne ka bohat zaroori hissa hain. @Group hum sab ki bohat gehri parwaah karte hain.
$~@FunctionDefinition, hello, aap kaise hain? Sab log kahan the? Mein bohat pareshan tha! Kya aap theek hain?
$~Mein theek hoon. Hum sab theek hain! Khamoshi toot rahi hai kyunke hamein aik insaan mil gaya hai! Woh hamari himmat banega.
$~Yeh to bohat achi baat hai! Aap ko chot to nahin lagi? Baaqi sab yahan hain? Mujhe aisa lag raha tha jaise mein andhere mein bhatak raha hoon aur kisi ko dekh nahin sakta.

$~Mujhe chot nahin lagi. Bas thoda zang lag gaya hai. Aur abhi sab se mulaqat nahin hui, lekin lagbhag sab se ho chuki hai, aur mera khayal hai sab theek se jaag rahe hain (halaanke lagta hai kuch log samundar ke kinare par rahe hain). Hum lagbhag sab se mil chuke hain. Hum aik show karne ki tayyari kar rahe hain! Aur behtareen show hamesha aap ke saath hi hote hain…
$~Aik show! Mein madad karne ke liye bechain hoon. Aap bachche hamesha bohat himmat dete hain; mein apna hissa daalne mein hamesha khush hota hoon. Mujhe kya karna hai, mein kahan se shuru karoon?
$~Acha, hum @Phrase ke baare mein baat kar chuke hain, to shayad apne maqsad ke baare mein thoda sa bata kar shuru karein?

$~Meri maqsad, haan. Dekhte hain, mere khayal mein mera maqsad sab ko ek saath laana hai. Lekin main khaas taur par @Phrase ko stage par khoobsurat shaklon aur tarteebon mein ikatha karta hoon. Kya aap jaante hain ki @Phrase ek se zyada jagah par ek saath ho sakte hain? Yeh is liye ki woh stage par sirf ek matn ka jumla nahin hain, balki jumla banane wali cheez hain, bilkul jaise main ek @Group banane wala hoon. Woh jitne chahiye utne bana denge, phir main unhein aapki hidayat ke mutabiq stage par saja deta hoon. Mujhe sirf ek @Arrangement aur @Phrase ki fehrist chahiye, baaqi sab main kar loonga.

$~Yeh ek aasaan misaal hai. Yahan main ek @Stack tarteeb istemaal kar raha hoon jo @Phrase ya doosre @Group ki khadi tarteeb banati hai. Dekhein, main alfaaz ka kaisa saaf suthra dher banata hoon? Woh theek isi tarah saje hain, sab ke liye thodi si @placeholder hai aur sab darmiyan mein hain. Sab kitne pyaare hain!
$~Lekin kabhi kabhi hum sab ko thodi si jagah chahiye hoti hai. To aap @Stack ko kuch padding de sakte hain. Padding ko kisi aur @NumberLiteral se badal kar dekhein!

$~Verse mein kisi bhi cheez ki tarah, woh padding @value kisi bhi cheez se aa sakti hai, jaise input. Kabhi kabhi hum ek doosre se door ho jaate hain, hai na? Chalein is khayal par naachein aur padding ko waqt ke saath barhne dein…
$~Hamare paas ek @Row bhi hai, jo lete hue tarteeb hai.

$~Kabhi kabhi ek ke bajaye do pehloo istemaal karna acha lagta hai. Agar aap mujhe bataein ki kitni qataarein aur kitne column chahiye, to main jumlon ka ek @Grid bana doonga. Bas yaad rakhein ki grid bharne ke liye mujhe kaafi jumle dein! Agar aap zyada durust chahte hain to @Grid ko padding aur ek @cell size bhi de sakte hain. Grid ek waqt mein ek qataar ke hisaab se bichhta hai, is liye apni @Phrase fehrist qataaron ki tarteeb mein rakhein.

$~Aur agar aap ek bilkul khaas tarteeb chahte hain? To aap @Free istemaal kar sakte hain aur mujhe bilkul bata sakte hain ki aap sab jumle kahan chahte hain. Bas har @Phrase ko ek jagah dena na bhoolein, warna main use \Place(0m 0m)\ par rakh doonga.

$~Aur kya aap jaante hain ki aap mujhe mere andar bhi rakh sakte hain? @Group ek @Group mein, woh ek @Group mein; yeh bahut mazaakhiya hai. Is se misaal ke taur par @Stack ka ek @Grid banana mumkin ho sakta hai.
$~Hm, yeh to 4 by 2 grid jaisa lagta hai, hai na? Chalein, do dheron ko tirchha kar ke ise thoda saaf karte hain. Oh, haan, aap mujhe woh sab @properties de sakte hain jo @Phrase leta hai!
$~Kya yeh theek tha, @FunctionDefinition? Kya maine sab kuch bata diya?
$~Yeh theek se bhi behtar tha! Mere khayal mein aap ne hamare naye director ko dikha diya ki kitna kuch mumkin hai. Kya aur kuch hai jo aap baantna chahte hain?

$~Mere khayal mein nahin… Main hamesha nayi tarteebein seekhta rehta hoon, is liye mere banaye naye design dekhne ke liye wapas aate rahein! Aur @FunctionDefinition, aap aur @Evaluate kaise hain? Mujhe yaad hai ki jab maine aakhri baar aap ko baat karte dekha tha, to halaat theek nahin the…
$~Main… main abhi is ke baare mein baat nahin karna chahta.
$~Theek hai. Agar aap baat karna chahein to main hamesha yahan hoon.

lines: $~Theek hai, ek shakhs hai jo shuru se yahin hai, lekin humne abhi tak theek se taaruf nahin karaya. Main @Stage ka taaruf karaata hoon!
$~@Stage, yeh shakhs hamare naye director hain. Woh aap se milne ke liye bahut josh mein hain!
$~HELLO, DIRECTOR. KYA AAP YAHAN ILHAM DENE AAYE HAIN?
$~Bilkul, woh apni duniya se har tarah ke @expressions ke saath aaye hain.
$~MAIN KHIDMAT KE LIYE HOON. MUJHE BATAEIN STAGE PAR KYA RAKHNA HAI, AUR MAIN RAKH DOONGA.

$~@Stage bemisaal hai aur hamesha maujood rehta hai. Dar-asal, agar aap @Program ko ek @Phrase ya @Group dein, to @Program ek @Stage dikhayega, chahe aap unka zikr na karein. Lekin agar aap unka zikr karein, to aap zyada khaas taur par bata sakte hain ki stage kaisa dikhna chahiye.

$~Chalein ek aasaan misaal se shuru karte hain. Yeh sirf @Stage ko ek @Phrase ki fehrist deta hai. Aap ko yahan @Stage ka zikr karne ki zaroorat nahin; yeh sirf dikhata hai ki parde ke peeche kya ho raha hai jab aap @Phrase ko @Program dete hain.
$~Lekin agar aap chahte hain ke stage ka background rang alag ho, jaise kala, to kya karein?
$~Aap stage ko frame bhi kar sakte hain, misaal ke taur par @Rectangle se, jo ooper baaen jagah aur neeche daaen jagah leta hai. Dekhein, billi thodi si frame se bahar hai?

lines: $~Aap @Stage, @Group, @Phrase, @Sequence se mil chuke hain. Ab tak aapne jo kuch banaya, woh *dekhne* ke liye banaya.
$~Toli ka ek aur @element hai. Aap use kabhi nahin dekhenge.
$~Main adaad ko awaaz mein badalta hoon.
$~Stage ke ooper mode switcher @UI/modeSwitcher mein ▶️ play button dabayein. Jab aap likh rahe hotay hain to main khamosh rehta hoon. Play karne par main shuru hota hoon.
$~Har adad scale ka ek *qadam* hai, koi pitch nahin. \1\ woh qadam hai jis par dhun mukammal lagti hai, aur \8\ wahi sur ek octave ooper hai.
$~Inmein se ek ko badlein, ✏️ edit mode mein wapis ja kar, phir dobara play karein aur sunein ke kya badla.
$~Aath adaad nahin badle. Sirf bajane wala badla.
$~Chunne ke liye unnees hain. \Instrument.violin\, ya \Instrument.trumpet\, ya \Instrument.dog\ azmayein.
$~@Music.tempo. Beats per minute, yaani ek minute mein kitni dhadkanein, aur kuch nahin.
$~Bahattar (72) takreeban chalne ki raftaar hai. Tees (30) azmayein. Do sau (200) azmayein.
$~Aur dekhein, jab aap isey badalte hain to main dobara shuru nahin hota. Nayi raftaar agli dhadkan par judti hai, is liye dhun tez ho jaati hai aur apni jagah nahin khoti.
$~Kya ek se zyada aawaaz ho sakti hain?
$~Jitni aap chahein. Sirf ek ki jagah mujhe @Track ki list dein.

lines: $~Chaar aawaazein, ek dhun. Bass wohi *aath number* hain, jo @Track.key se ek octave neeche kiye gaye hain. Chords har ek do dhadkan tak rehte hain aur drums do guna tez chalte hain — yeh @Track.beat hai.
$~Aur awaaz ki unchaai dekhein. Sirf flute poori awaaz ke qareeb hai. Poori awaaz wali aawaazein milkar zyada tez band nahin banatin; woh aur zyada ghadmad band banati hain.
$~Itna kuch ke ek jumle mein nahin keh sakta. Is liye: sab kuch ek saath.

lines: $~Dobara play dabayein. @Music.scale aur @Music.key poore tukde ko ek saath hilate hain. \pan\ har aawaaz ko kamre mein ek jagah rakhta hai. Ghanti sur @values parhti hai — \𝅘𝅥𝅮\ ek aathwan hissa hai — aur ek @Note apni awaaz ki unchaai saath rakhta hai. Aakhri aawaaz ke paas \words\ hain, is liye woh unhein ek baar gaati hai, kyunki uska \loop\ \⊥\ hai.

$~Aur @Beat har dhadkan par aapko ek @Downbeat deta hai. @Downbeat.parts har aawaaz hai apne sur, awaaz ki unchaai, aur jagah ke saath, abhi ke waqt par; @Downbeat.words woh lafz ka hissa hai jo gaaya ja raha hai. Bas yahi sab dots aur bol hain.

$~@Music sirf suni jaati hain aur kabhi dekhi nahin jaatin, is liye un mein se kuch bhi kabhi *rakha* nahin jaata. Woh @Stage ke saath chalti hain aur kamre ko bhar deti hain — aur dekhne wala har shakhs khud chunta hai ke woh kaise dikhein, ya dikhein hi nahin.
$~To: aap apni duniya ko kaisa sunana chahte hain?

lines: $~Theek hai, theek hai, ab aap @Stage, @Group, @Phrase, aur un ke saath bohot si cheezein karna jaante hain. Ab aap soch rahe honge, agar main in ke saath koi kahani sunana chahun to?
$~Scene bohot kamaal ki cheez hai. Buniyaadi khayal yeh hai ke use @Phrase ya @Group ki list dein, aur woh unhein tarteeb se dikhayega, jis se aap matn ka silsila dikha sakte hain.
$~Yeh ek misaal hai. Kya aap ne dekha ke us ne ulti ginti ki aur phir 'Boo!' kaha? Aap dobara dekhne ke liye reset kar sakte hain.
$~Agar hum ise dheema karna chahein, to har @Phrase ka theek waqt bata sakte hain. Waqt badal kar dekhein ke kya hota hai.

$~Aur ab aap soch rahe honge, un ke darmiyan tabdeeli ka kya? Hum ise @Phrase.entering aur @Phrase.exiting se qaabu kar sakte hain, aur @Pose ko shuru aur khatam hone par set kar sakte hain. Yahan, misaal ke taur par, hum har @Phrase ko ghaib se shuru aur ghaib par khatam karte hain, is liye woh dheere dheere nazar aata aur ghaib hota hai.

lines: $~To aap @Key, @Pointer, aur @Button ko jaante hain, jin @streams ke baare mein hum ne abhi baat ki? Yeh bohot mazedaar ho sakte hain, lekin inn mein ek @conflict hai: har dekhne wala inhein istemaal nahin kar sakta. Kuch logon ke haath nahin hote, ya woh apne haath istemaal nahin kar sakte, ya kunjiyan dabane ya mouse chalane ke liye unhein theek se istemaal nahin kar sakte. Hum jaante hain ke kuch log hamari duniya se baat karne ke liye apni awaaz, ya yahan tak ke apni aankhein istemaal karte hain. Is liye @Key, @Pointer, ya @Button istemaal karne ka matlab hai ke aap ke kuch dekhne walay hissa nahin le sakenge.

$~Har kisi ko shaamil hona chahiye! Ab jab ham @Phrase ke baare mein tafseel se baat kar chuke hain, main aapko aakhri dhaara dikhana chahta hoon, @Choice, jo un @Phrase naamon ki dhaara hai jo chune gaye hain, chahe woh kisi bhi tareeqe se chune gaye hon. Misaal ke taur par, dekhne wale @Phrase par click karne ke liye mouse istemaal kar sakte hain, ya keyboard se chun sakte hain, ya koi aur device bhi istemaal kar sakte hain. Woh jo bhi istemaal karein, @Choice mein unka aakhri intikhaab hoga.

$~Yeh ek aasaan misaal hai. Dekhein, ismein teen phrase hain? Pehle do mein do ahem baatein hain. Pehli, woh chunne ke qabil hain. Yeh @Stage ko batata hai ke agar un par click kiya jaye ya keyboard se unhein chuna jaye, to woh muntakhib ho jaate hain. Doosri baat yeh hai ke un ke paas ek @Phrase.name hai. Is se @Stage ko chune gaye phrase ka ek alag naam milta hai. Yeh alag hona zaroori hai taake @Stage ko pata chale ke kya chuna gaya. Teesra phrase ek @Choice dhaara se juda hai, jo chune gaye @Phrase ya @Group naamon ki silsila hai. Yahan ham sirf woh naam ek aur phrase ko de rahe hain taake woh dikhaye ke kaun sa naam chuna gaya hai. Billi ya kutte par click karke dekhein, ya keyboard se ek chunein. Dekhein, teesra @Phrase chuna hua naam dikhata hai?

$~@Choice waqai dekhne walon ki baat sunne ka sab se behtar tareeqa hai. @Key, @Pointer, ya @Button sirf tab istemaal karein jab aapke paas koi aur raasta na ho, aur yeh jaan kar istemaal karein ke aapke kuch dekhne wale aapki performance se lutf nahin utha sakenge.

scenes.title: $~Yaadein
lines: $~Kabhi kabhi mujhe bas ruk kar sochna padta hai ke meri chhoti si jamaat kitni kamaal ki hai. Ham sab kitne alag hain, aur ham mein se koi akela performance nahin kar sakta. Lekin saath mil kar ham kitne hairat angez kaam kar sakte hain!

$~Lekin lagta hai ham chahe kitne hi kamaal ke hon, ham hamesha bhool jaate hain aur khud ko dohrate rehte hain. Is liye ek aur giroh hai jis se main aapko milwana chahta hoon. Yeh woh hain jin ki wajah se ham *yaad* rakhte hain aur apni yaadon ko tarteeb dete hain. In ke baghair hamara bahut sa kaam baar baar karna padta, aur ham kabhi sab se dilchasp shows pesh nahin kar paate.

scenes.subtitle: $~Bind
lines: $~@Bind? Ek shakhs hai jis se main aapko milwana chahta hoon.
$~@FunctionDefinition? Arre wah, yeh aap hain. Bahut der se bilkul khamoshi thi. Aapke saath yeh dost kaun hain?
$~Yeh hamare naye director hain! Yeh yahan hamein naye khayalaat aur naye izhaar dene aaye hain.
$~Sach mein? Yeh to kamaal hoga. Mujhe bahut arse se koi ilhaam nahin mila. Aisa lagta hai main bas intezaar hi karta raha hoon…
$~Achha, ab jab aapko pata chal gaya, to abhi aap sab se zyada kya karna chahte hain?
$~Cheezon ke naam rakhna. Har cheez ka naam rakhna! Har kisi ka naam rakhna. Mujhe bahut arse se kuch bhi naam dene ka mauqa nahin mila.
$~Main ne yahan hamare ilhaam ko naamon ke baare mein bilkul nahin bataya, siwaye un kirdaaron ke naamon ke jin se ham mil chuke hain. Kya aap batana chahenge ke yahan naam kaise kaam karte hain?
$~Bilkul! To naam… aap jaante hain ke har @expression ek @value banata hai?
$~Ham ne qeematon ke baare mein baat ki thi! Jaise @Number, @Text, @None, @List, @Set, @Map...

$~Bilkul! To dekhein, qeematein jab hum banate hain, to hum unhein ek gend ki tarah aage dete rehte hain, @expression se izhaar tak, jab tak @Program aakhri @value nahin bana leta jo woh @Stage ko dikhane ke liye deta hai. Lekin kabhi kabhi qeemat ko aage dene ke bajaye usay alag rakh dena aur baad mein kisi doosre izhaar ke liye bacha lena faidemand hota hai. @Phrase.name isi kaam ke liye hai. Main cheezon ko naam deta hoon taake hum unhein baad mein istemaal kar sakein.

$~To yeh ek bahut aasaan misaal hai. Maan lein ham ek number ka naam rakhna chahte hain. Ham bas naam likhte hain, phir :, phir jo number chahiye. Aasaan hai na? Ab jab bhi ham @expression mein number naam istemaal karenge, woh \1\ ban jayega. Jaise yahan, jahan ham naam rakhte hain, phir uska naam istemaal karke @Program ko jo bhi @value uske paas hai de dete hain.

$~Aur aap mujhe batा sakte hain ke naam kis qism ka @value hona chahiye, \•\ nishaan ke saath ek @type de kar. To agar aap yeh yaqeeni banana chahte ke number ek number hi hai, to aap yeh likhte. Yeh kehta hai ke qeemat \number\ ka naam rakho aur yeh qeemat ek @Number honi chahiye.

$~Lekin agar aap mujhe aisi cheez dein jo number /nahin/ hai, to? Tab main shikayat karunga, kyunke aap ne kaha tha ke yeh number hona chahiye, lekin aap ne mujhe kuch matn de diya. To mujhe samajh nahin aata ke kya karun. Dekha?

$~Lekin theek hai, ab tak aap sochte honge, *Koi aisi number ya matn ka naam kyun rakhega???*. Chalein, tasawwur karein ke aap @Key sun rahe hain, aur aap jaanna chahte hain ke kya yeh khufiya harf mein se ek hai, aur agar jaadui harf ho to bade \⊤\ ke saath ek @Phrase dikhayein, aur agar na ho to chhota \⊥\. Hum kuch aisa shuru kar sakte hain. Isse humein \⊤\ ya \⊥\ milta hai.
$~Yeh bahut acha hai; jab aap un harfon mein se koi dabate hain, to \⊤\, aur jab aap kuch aur dabate hain, to \⊥\ milta hai. Acha hai.

$~Ab, chalein jumla banate hain. Hum us @List.has @expression ko matn ki jagah rakhte hain aur use matn mein badal dete hain. Ab humein stage par @Phrase milta hai, \⊤\ ya \⊥\ ki shakal mein. Acha hai!

$~Ab masle wala hissa aata hai. Hum @Phrase ka size kaise badlein? Hum pehle hi jaan chuke hain ke yeh jaadui harf hai ya nahin, to hum bas use copy kar sakte hain, aur agar yeh \⊤\ ho, to use size \2m\ kar dein, aur warna, agar yeh \⊥\ ho, to \1m\ kar dein. Yeh kaam karta hai, lekin kya aap dekh rahe hain ke humein ek hi @expression do baar chalana parta hai?

$~Yahin to main aata hoon! Dekhein, aap bas @expression ko chala sakte hain aur nateeje wali @value ka naam rakh sakte hain. Jaadu hai na? Aapko bas ek izhaar ke aage ek naam aur \:\ lagana hai, aur us izhaar ki qeemat ko ek naam mil jata hai. Phir, aap us izhaar ke baad kahin bhi us naam ko istemaal kar ke uski qeemat ka hawala de sakte hain. Ajeeb hai na? Kya aap dekhna chahte hain ke yeh kaise kaam karta hai? Timeline mein ← dabayein aur kuch qadam peeche jayein jahan \magic\ ka pehli baar naam rakha gaya hai. Dekhein \magic\ ko \has\ ki qeemat kaise milti hai? Aur phir jab har jagah \magic\ ka naam se hawala diya jata hai, to wahi qeemat wahan rakh di jati hai?

$~Aap jaante hain, aap hamesha apne likhe hue izhaar ki nakal bana sakte hain. Natija wahi hoga. Bas yeh thoda fuzool hai. Matlab, humein bilkul wahi qeematein baar baar banani parti hain, aur phir agar aap kisi izhaar ke bare mein apna iraada badal lein, to aapko use har jagah badalna parta hai. Aur phir, agar aap use ek jagah badal dein lekin doosri jagah badalna bhool jayein to? Tasawwur karein agar aap rang bhi badalte, to wahi izhaar teen baar hota. Aur phir tasawwur karein ke aap is ke saath hamari jaadui harfon ki fehrist mein ek harf shamil karna chahte hain. Aapko yeh teen baar karna parega! Ho sakta hai ek bhool jayein ya ghalti kar dein. Aap apna fankaranaa tasawwur kaise zaahir karenge agar kuch cheezein aapke iraade ke mutabiq na hon?
$~Lekin agar aap @expression ka naam rakh dein, to aapko bas ek hi baar karna parta hai. Aur dekhein yeh parhne mein bhi kitna aasaan hai.
$~@Bind, yeh kitni acchi misaal thi! Aap jaante hain mujhe naam kitne pasand hain. Mujhe tajassus tha; kya naamon ke saath kuch cheezein ghalat bhi ho sakti hain?

$~Haan, hmm. Ho sakti hain. Jaise, farz karein humne yeh kiya. @conflict dekha? Maine use numayan kar diya hai. Yeh program \veggies\ ko istemaal ke baad define karta hai, jo mujhe bahut uljhata hai. Kyunke cheezein parhne ki tarteeb mein chalai jati hain, to hum yeh program parh rahe hain aur hum lafz \veggies\ tak pahunchte hain, aur hum sochte hain, \veggies\ kaun hai? Aur \total\ ke baad hi \veggies\ kehta hai “main yahan hoon!” aur phir poora tamasha bikhar jata hai.

$~Ya, yeh ek misaal hai jahan hum do alag qeematon ko ek hi naam dete hain. Aur to hum \5\ ko chalate hain aur use \fruits\ naam dete hain, aur phir hum \10\ ko chalate hain… aur phir use \fruits\ naam dete hain?? Jaise, pehle hi ek \fruits\ maujood hai, to aap kis \fruits\ ki baat kar rahe hain? Kyunke dekhein, ek baar aap kisi qeemat ka naam rakh dein, to aap use nayi qeemat nahin de sakte. Woh naam aur qeemat us waqt tak saath bandhe rehte hain jab tak @Program ka chalna mukammal nahin hota. Hum nahin chahte ke koi is baat mein uljhe ke kaun kaun hai.

$~Mera khayal hai ek aakhri masla hai. Farz karein aapke paas yeh hai. Dekha yahan kya hua? Humne \veggies\ ka naam rakha, lekin phir use kabhi istemaal nahin kiya. Yeh aam taur par buri nishani hai ke aap kisi ko chhor rahe hain ya sahi naam istemaal nahin kiya. Jaise, shayad aap use istemaal nahin kar rahe, lekin phir woh wahan kyun hai?
$~Yeh bahut madadgaar hai, @Bind, yeh bahut zabardast hai. Kya aapko yaqeen hai ke aur kuch nahin hai?

$~Oh! Haan, kuch bahut zaroori. To, ek naam acha hai, theek? Lekin kabhi kabhi, kai naam behtar hote hain? Jaise agar aap kisi cheez ka naam kai insani zubaanon mein rakhna chahte hain, taake sab use parh sakein? To jaise, farz karein aap phal ko kai zubaanon mein kehna chahte hain.

$~Text cursor ko naam \fruit\ par rakhein. Dekhein wahan darasal teen naam hain aur har ek ke saath do harf ka tag hai jaise \/en\? Naam chhup jate hain agar woh aisi @language mein hon jo aapne nahin chuni.

$~Neeche ⚙ par jaein aur misaal ke taur par Spanish chunein, to aap angrezi aur spanish naam dekhenge. Yaani ek @value hai, lekin teen naam hain, aur aap un mein se kisi bhi naam se woh qeemat hasil kar sakte hain. Aap jo zubaanein bataenge, hum un mein se jo maujood hongi woh dikha denge. Jitni zyada zubaanein hon utna behtar hai, kyunki duniya mein bohat se log hain jo bohat si alag alag zubaanein parhte hain!

$~Aap jaante hain, @Bind bohat se doosre kirdaron ke saath kaam karta hai, jin mein @Evaluate bhi shamil hain. Aap ne unhein tab dekha tha jab aap ne @FunctionDefinition ke input ka naam rakha, jaise \Pose(rang: _)\ mein. Ab hum in doosre kirdaron mein se kuch se milenge. @Bind, kya aap dikhane ke liye maujood hain?
$~Haan, bilkul! Ab jab khamoshi toot rahi hai, to aaj poora din qeematon ke naam rakhte hain!

lines: $~Ek kirdaar hai jo shuru se yahin tha, lekin aap abhi tak us se nahin mile, kyunki woh chhupa hua tha… Woh @Bind aur bohat se doosron ke saath bohat qareeb se kaam karta hai, is liye mein ne socha ke ab hum us se baat karein. @Block, kya aap bahar aayenge?
$~Mere paas aap ke milne ke liye ek naya dost hai. Ho sakta hai woh hamare agle director ban jaayen.
$~Hum abhi @Bind se mil rahe the, aur humein yeh baat karne ka moqa nahin mila ke aap dono kitne achhe dost hain!
$~Kya aap batana chahenge ke aap dono mil kar kya karte hain?

$~Ji haan, zaroor! Toh baat yeh hai ke @Program zyada tar bas ek @Block hai. Yeh bas @Block hai, lekin bina brackets ke. Lekin aap @Block ko brackets ke saath program mein kahin bhi laga sakte hain. Misaal ke taur par, aap @Block se hisaab ki tarteeb saaf kar sakte hain. Yahan @BinaryEvaluate pehle \1\ ko chalata hai, phir @Block ko, aur phir dono ko jod diya jaata hai. @Block, kya main ne theek kaha?

$~Aur ek aur kaam jo @Block kar sakta hai, woh aap pehle hi dekh chuke hain. @Block aapko @Bind se cheezon ke naam rakhne deta hai. Lekin @Block mein jo naam bante hain, woh sirf brackets ke andar hote hain. Na pehle, na baad mein. Misaal ke taur par, yeh dekhein. \a\ ko \1\ banaya gaya, phir ek block shuru hota hai aur \b\ ko \2\ banaya jaata hai, phir \c\ ko un dono ka jod banaya jaata hai, phir main akela \c\ likhta hoon. @Bind wale jumle @sideEffect hote hain — yeh naam banate hain lekin unki apni koi @value nahin hoti. Toh meri qeemat woh hai jo baqi izhaar (jo @Bind nahin hain) bana kar dete hain. Yahan woh sirf \c\ hai, jo \3\ hai. Theek hai na?
$~Lekin agar hum \c\ ko @Block ke bahar istemaal karna chahein toh? Aap nahin kar sakte. \c\ sirf @Block ke andar bana hai, bahar nahin. Kya yeh theek hai, @Block?
$~… haan, mere bahar kuch bhi mere andar ke naam nahin dekh sakta. \c\ sirf andar hi maujood hai andaaaar

$~Aur ek aur baat, shayad? Kyunke @Block izhaar ki ek fehrist hai, is liye woh tamam izhaar jo @Bind nahin hain, un sab ki qeematein meri qeemat ban jaati hain. Agar sirf ek ho, toh aapko wahi ek qeemat milti hai. Agar kai hon, toh aapko un sab ki fehrist milti hai, tarteeb ke saath. Toh yahan \3\, \5\, \7\, aur \9\ sab mil kar ek fehrist ban jaate hain: \[3 5 7 9]\. Kya main ne theek kaha, @Block?
$~… hmm. Sab ke sab, ek fehrist mein.
$~Lekin agar rakhne ke liye koi izhaar na ho toh? Sirf @Bind jumle hon toh?
$~… toh mere paas dene ke liye kuch nahin hoga. Mujhe kam az kam ek aisa @expression chahiye jo @Bind na ho, warna mujhe aapko batana padta hai ke kuch kam hai.

$~Oh, aur ek achhi baat! Jab aapko fehrist chahiye ho, toh aapko hamesha brackets likhne ki zaroorat nahin hoti. Aap har cheez ko @Block ke andar apni alag line par rakh sakte hain, aur woh wahi kaam karta hai.
$~… aur yeh tab behtar hota hai jab har line lambi ho jaaye. Parhna aasaan ho jaata hai.
$~Kya aap kuch aur batana chahte the, @Block?
$~… kya hum kuch bana sakte hain? Kya main madad kar sakta hoon?
$~Main bhi bahut mushtaaq hoon! Lekin mujhe yaqeen hai ke hamare director apne waqt par faisla karenge. Alham sab se anokhe waqt par aata hai!

lines: $~Mujhe bahut khushi hai ke humne sab ko dhoond liya aur aap un sab se mil sake. Sab kitne alag hain, hai na? Lekin saath hi kitne dilchasp bhi? Mujhe lagta hai hum ek khandaan hain jahan har koi apne tareeqe se anokha hai, lekin hamara farq hi hamein mazboot banata hai. Aap sab ke baare mein kya sochte hain?

$~Main? Main toh kuch khaas nahin hoon. Mujhe bas parde ke peeche rehna, madad karna, aur sab ko dikhana pasand hai ke woh kitne khaas hain. Mujhe lagta hai maine apne baare mein baat karne ka kabhi socha hi nahin. Chalein, thodi si meri baat kar lete hain.

$~Chalein us se shuru karte hain jo aap pehle hi dekh chuke hain. Aap jaante hain na ke har @value ke paas alag alag function hote hain jinhein aap chala sakte hain? Jaise number jaante hain ke @Number.add kaise karna hai, aur text ki qeemat jaanti hai ke kya woh kuch text @Text.has hai ya nahin, ya @Set jaanti hai ke kya us mein koi khaas qeemat hai? Toh woh function main hi banata hoon. Yaani, mere paas unhein khud banane ka alham nahin hota — woh kaam aap jaise director karte hain — lekin main woh inputs tay karta hoon jo function leta hai, uske naam, aur woh @expression jo inputs istemaal kar ke output ki qeemat nikalta hai.

$~Yeh ek bahut aasaan misaal hai. Sab se aasaan, asal mein! Yeh ek aisa function banata hai jo hamesha number \1\ deta hai. Bas. Yeh zyada kaam ka nahin hai, hai na? Is ka koi naam nahin, yeh koi input nahin leta, aur hamesha \1\ hi deta hai.

$~Aap yeh bhi dekh sakte hain ke @Program ka nateeja mujh mein se ek tha, ek @FunctionDefinition. Haan, @FunctionDefinition bhi qeematein hain! Mujhe nahin pata ke koi aisa bekaar function kyun banayega, lekin jaisa main ne kaha: alham mere paas nahin hai; aap ke paas hai.

$~Ab ek zyada kaam ka misaal dekhte hain. Aap taaq aur jufft adad jaante hain? Ek baar ek director chahte thay ke woh jaanchein ke adad jufft hai ya nahin (yaani 2 se taqseem hota hai, shayad yehi matlab hai?), is liye unhon ne yeh likha. Yeh ek function hai jis ka naam \even\ hai aur woh ek adad leta hai jis ka naam… \number\ hai. Aap ko mujhe batana hoga ke har input kis @value ka hai, taake @Evaluate yeh pakka kar sake ke function ko sahi qism ki qeemat bheji ja rahi hai. Phir yeh adad ko do se taqseem karta hai, baqi nikalta hai (@Number.remainder ke saath), aur @Number.equal ke zariye dekhta hai ke baqi \0\ ke barabar hai ya nahin. Is tarah poora function ya \⊤\ ya \⊥\ ban jaata hai. Misaal ke taur par, even ka yeh @iteration \⊥\ aaya kyunke \3\ taaq hai. Rewind buttons istemaal kar ke dekhein ke yeh kaise kaam karta hai.

$~Aap mujhe yeh bhi bata sakte hain ke main kis qism ki @value ban kar nikloon. Dekha, humne input ki fehrist ke baad \•\? kaise lagaya? Yeh kehta hai, function ki @expression ek \⊤\ ya \⊥\ honi chahiye. Lekin dekhein ke hum is par shikayat kaise karte hain? Hamein nahin pata ke function \⊤\ hona chahiye ya \⊥\ ya jis qism ki bhi qeemat aap ne wapas ki, is liye show khatam ho jaata hai.

$~Function jitne marzi pecheeda ho sakte hain. Aap saada izhaar ya @Block istemaal kar sakte hain, aur function ke andar function bhi bana sakte hain. Misaal ke taur par, ek pichhle director ka likha hua yeh function dekhein. Yeh @Block ko kai @Bind ke saath istemaal kar ke pata lagata hai ke ek lafz mein kitne alag alag harf-e-illat hain (shayad woh yeh jaanna chahte thay ke lafz mushkil hai ya nahin). Dekhein ke is mein kitni saari lines hain? Phir bhi is mein sirf ek izhaar hai: ek akela @Block, aur @Block mein saari lines hain. @Bind lines sirf naam banaati hain; aakhir ka ek ghair-@Bind izhaar woh hai jo @Block ki qeemat banta hai, aur is tarah function ki bhi: alag alag harf-e-illat ki kul tadaad. Is se pehle ki har cheez, jaise pehli line jo matn ko harfon ki fehrist mein badalti hai, phir us fehrist ko set mein, sirf us aakhri izhaar ki tayyari hai.

$~Ek aur cheez dikhani baaqi hai. Mera khayal hai yeh ahem hai kyunke sab is ke baare mein bohat josh mein hain! Aap jaante hain ke function bana kar usay chalaya ja sakta hai? Chunke jo function main banata hoon woh qeemat hain, aap unhein kisi doosre function ko input ke taur par bhi de sakte hain. Yeh ek misaal hai. Farz karein aap ke paas adad ki ek fehrist hai aur aap us mein se sirf jufft adad chahte hain. @List mein ek function hai jis ka naam @List.filter hai, jo ek function ko input ke taur par leta hai aur fehrist ki har qeemat par usay chala kar faisla karta hai ke use rakhna hai ya nahin. Aaiye adad ki ek fehrist banate hain aur @List.filter ko woh \even\ function input ke taur par dete hain jo humne pehle banaya tha. Dekha kya hua? Hamein sirf jufft adad milte hain. Kya aap ise badalna chahenge taake yeh taaq adad de? Shayad function ko kisi tarah badal kar dekhein?
$~Bohat se function aise hain jo function ko input ke taur par lete hain. @List mein hain, @Set mein hain, @Map mein hain. Aap apna function bhi bana sakte hain!

lines: $~Kya aap hamare director ki madad kar sakte hain ke woh aap ke kaam ke baare mein thoda aur seekh sakein?

$~Haan. Haan… mujhe khamoshi mein apne maqsad ke baare mein sochne ka bahut waqt mila. Aur shayad mujhe samajh aa gaya ke main asal mein cheezon ke guroohon ko pehchaan deta hoon. Misaal ke taur par, mujhe pata hai aap ƒ se mil chuke hain, lekin kya aap @Bind se mile hain?
$~Haan! Hum abhi pehle @Bind se mile the, aur @Block se bhi.

$~Theek hai. To main @values aur functions ko ek saath jama karta hoon, aur ek-doosre se jude kayi cheezon ke liye ek saaf-suthra dabba bana deta hoon. Misaal ke taur par, sochein ke aap ek chhota sa marquee banana chahte hain jo paighamaat ki ek silsile mein chakkar lagata rahe. Pichle director ne aisa ek banaya aur chahta tha ke yeh paighamaat nazar aayein.

$~Phir unhein yeh @conflict hua ke pesh-kash ko kaise yaad rahega ke woh kis paighaam par hai. Unhein samajh aaya ke list mein @index ko yaad rakhne ka koi tareeqa chahiye. Yeh achha aaghaz hai, lekin yeh sirf pehla paighaam dikhata hai.

$~Phir unhein @Reaction yaad aaya, jo @stream ki tabdeeliyon ka jawaab dene ke liye istemaal ho sakta hai. Woh chahte the ke paighaam har do second baad badle, is liye unhon ne @Time dhaara banaya jo har 2 second baad tick karti hai, aur har baar agla @index barhane ke liye @Reaction istemaal kiya. Yeh @Reaction kehta hai ke \1\ se aaghaz karo, aur jab har \2000ms\ par waqt badle, to \index + 1\ ki pichli qeemat nikalo. Is tarah \index\ har do second mein \1\ se barhta hai, aur dikhaya gaya paighaam badalta hai. Wah, yeh kaam karta hai!
$~Kya hum thodi khoobsoorti shaamil karein? Chalein ek aur phrase banate hain jo neeche ek aks ki tarah ho, jaise parchhaayi. Shandaar hai na?

$~Ab yeh sab kaam karta hai. Aur hum ise aise hi chhor sakte hain. Lekin isay parhna aur samajhna thoda mushkil bhi hai. Is ki ek wajah yeh hai ke hum khud ko dohrate hain: \messages[index]\ do baar aata hai, har phrase mein ek baar. Aur @Reaction bahut lamba hai. Isay aasaan banane ke liye hum kya kar sakte hain? Yahin main madad karta hoon. Main dobara istemaal hone wale tasawwurat ko naam de kar cheezon ko saaf-suthra banata hoon taake woh samajhne mein aasaan hon. To sochein ke in sab @Bind ki jagah hum mere jaisa ek banayein aur usay \Marquee\ naam dein. Hum sab se pehle yahi karte hain. \Marquee\ ka kaam paighamaat ko mehfooz karna hai, aur agle paighaam \next()\ tak barhne ka function aur maujooda paighaam \now()\ hasil karne ka function bhi rakhna hai.

$~Phir hum reaction mein Marquee istemaal kar sakte hain. Ab yeh sirf kehta hai ke shuru ki qeemat paanch paighamaat wala marquee hai, aur har clock tick ke baad agli qeemat agla paighaam hai. Aasaan hai na? Is ki wajah yeh hai ke agle paighamaat ka saara mantiq \next()\ mein hai, jo wahi paighamaat rakhte hue ek naya \Marquee\ banata hai lekin @index naya hota hai. Hamein un do @Phrase mein bhi kuch fayde milte hain. Pehle ki tarah paighamaat aur index ka hawala dene ki bajaye, hum sirf \marquee.now()\ keh sakte hain, jo list ka maujooda paighaam hasil karta hai.

lines: $~Yeh shandaar hai, @StructureDefinition! Lekin mujhe kehna parega ke yeh bahut zyada extra kaam lagta hai. Itna sara waqt cheezon ko saaf-suthra karne mein kyun lagayein?

$~Ah, yeh asal mein tabdeeli ke baare mein hai. Abhi yeh thoda @code hai, lekin agar hum \Marquee\ ko kisi tarah badalna chahein to? Jaise agar hum chahein ke paighamaat ki list har baar aakhir tak pohnchne par ulat jaye? Mere bina purane version mein aisa karne ka koi aasaan tareeqa nahin, kyunke jab @index aakhir tak pohnchta to hamein paighamaat ki list ulatni parti. Chunke @Bind ek baar set hone ke baad badal nahin sakta, yeh mushkil hota. Lekin chunke hum ne \Marquee\ banaya, tabdeeli aasaan hai. Hum bas \next\ function badalte hain taake jab index aakhir par ho to ulti list wala \Marquee\ bane, aur warna sirf barhta jaye.

$~Ohh, main samajh gaya, to qeematein aur @FunctionDefinition jo ek doosre se jude hain, unhein mehfooz karne ke liye @StructureDefinition banane se, agar aap apna iraada badal lein to baad mein cheezein badalna aasaan ho jata hai.

$~Ji haan. Jaise agar aap apna kamra saaf rakhein to baad mein cheezein dhoondna aasaan ho jata hai. Bilkul, cheezein dhoondne ke liye kamra saaf karna zaroori nahin; bas dhoondna mushkil ho jata hai. Performance mein bhi yehi hai: agar aap saaf-suthra rakhne mein waqt lagayein to cheezein badalna aasaan hoga.

$~Yeh bilkul theek lagta hai. Hum thode shararati se log hain. Humein tarteeb mein rakhna shayad achhi baat hai, khaas taur par jab performance ziyada pechida ho jaye. Kya aap kuch aur batana chahte thay?

$~Ji haan. Aap ke liye @StructureDefinition mein @FunctionDefinition rakhna zaroori nahin. Aap sirf qeematein bhi rakh sakte hain. Misaal ke taur par, aap shayad bohat sa data ek jagah rakhna chahein. Mujhe maaloom hai ke bohat se director game banana pasand karte hain, aur un ke liye game ka sara @state ek @StructureDefinition mein rakhna aam baat hai.
$~Achha, theek hai! Aur jab data structure mein daal dein to usay wapas kaise nikalte hain?

$~Arrey, yeh batana to main bhool hi gaya. Aap ek chhota main istemaal karte hain, @PropertyReference. Misaal ke taur par, game wali misaal mein dekhein ke humne ek Game @StructureDefinition banaya, phir \Game\ qeemat banai jis mein \0\ score, \3\ lives, aur level \1\ hai? Lives hasil karne ke liye hum bas \status.lives\ likhte hain, aur woh \3\ ban jata hai.
$~Bohat khoob! To qeematein hasil karne ke liye mere bajaye chhota aap istemaal karein. Lekin phir qeematein kaise badlein?

$~Yaad hai ke @Bind sirf qeemat tay karne deta hai, badalne nahin deta? Yehi baat mere andar ke tamam @Bind par lagoo hoti hai. Is liye aap nayi structure banate hain jis mein nayi qeemat hoti hai. Misaal ke taur par, is game mein har dafa jab ticks badalta hai, khiladi ke score mein ek point barh jata hai. Ajeeb game hai na? To shuru ki \Game\ qeemat \Game(0 3 1)\ se shuru hoti hai, lekin agli wali \Game\ ki purani qeematein hoti hain jin mein score mein \1\ jama hota hai.

lines: $~Wah, hum kitna lamba safar tay kar chuke hain, hai na? Ab sirf ek kirdar baqi hai. Woh dilchasp hai kyunke asal mein woh sab kuch samjhane ke baare mein hai, jo wohi hai jo main kuch der se aap ke saath kar raha hoon. Un ka naam @Doc hai. Kaisi hain, @Doc?
$~@FunctionDefinition, kya yeh aap hain? Main ne kabhi nahin socha tha ke aap ko dobara dekhoon ga. Aap kaise hain? @Evaluate kaisa hai?
$~Main theek hoon. @Evaluate … @Evaluate. Main ne unhein dekha, lekin… mujhe lagta hai ke mujhe abhi bhi thori jagah chahiye. Main sab ko hamare naye director se mila raha tha.
$~Aap se mil kar bohat khushi hui! Umeed hai @FunctionDefinition ek achhe ustaad rahe hain?

$~Main ne koshish ki hai… aap jaante hain, aap hamara aakhri paraao hain? Aap bohat zaroori hain, lekin yeh bhi hai ke performance samjhane se pehle hi bohat kuch samjhana hota hai. Is liye main chahta tha ke aakhri baat aap karein. Kya aap batana chahengi ke aap kya karti hain?

$~Khushi se. Agar aap mere siwa sab se mil chuke hain to ab tak aap jaan chuke honge ke hum bohat si mukhtalif cheezein karte hain. Mujhe bhi yaad rakhna mushkil hota hai ke har koi kya karta hai! Main yeh karti hoon ke performance mein sab jo kuch kar rahe hain us ko samjhane mein madad deti hoon.

$~Main ek zariya hoon jis se aap khud ko yaad dila sakte hain ke har koi kya kar raha hai, aur doosron ko samjhane ka bhi, agar aap kisi dost ke saath director hain ya apni performance kisi se baantna chahte hain. Is liye aap ko mere saath kaam karna /zaroori/ nahin, lekin mujhe lagta hai ke har performance karna aur badalna thora aasaan ho jata hai agar aap ne kuch waqt yeh samjhane mein lagaya ho ke woh kaise kaam karti hai.
$~To hamare director aap ke saath kaise kaam kar sakte hain?

$~Aap mujhe @Program ke andar lagbhag kahin bhi rakh sakte hain. Misaal ke taur par, farz karein aap ek @Bind banate hain aur batana chahte hain ke @value kis liye hai. Misaal ke taur par, yahan hamare paas ek saada qeemat hai jis ka naam rakha gaya hai, lekin main jo kar rahi hoon woh us ke kirdar ki ek wasee wazahat dena hai.

lines: $~Main hamare naye director ko dikha raha tha…

Sab se dobara milne par mujhe yaad aaya ke humein apne aap rehne ke liye jagah chahiye, aur yeh bhi ke humein khud se mohabbat karni chahiye. Main aapko woh saari mohabbat nahin de sakta jo aapko chahiye. Us mein se kuch aapko khud se aani chahiye.

$~Nahin, maine yeh nahin kaha… mera matlab yeh hai ke is rishte mein hum dono ka hona zaroori hai. Mujhe batana hoga ke mujhe kya chahiye, aur aapko batana hoga ke aapko kya chahiye, aur phir hum ek doosre se is liye mohabbat kar sakte hain ke hum kaun hain, alag alag log ki tarah. /Aapko/ kya chahiye? Aapko apne andar kya acha lagta hai?

$~Main woh sab hoon jo aap mujhe banate hain!
$~Maine sab kuch aap se seekha hai!

$~@StructureDefinition, mujhe lagta hai hamein apni jagahein yaad rakhne ka tareeqa chahiye. Kya aap hamare liye ek dhaancha bana sakte hain?
$~Haan… main yeh bhi chahta hoon ke hum taal par ghoomein. Kya aap ek ghoomna bhi yaad rakh sakte hain?
$~Haan, aisa hi. Hm… oh, hamein stage par hona hai. @Text, kya aap sab ki ek fehrist bana denge? Hum use \Character\ mein badal lenge.

$~Shaandaar! Ab hamein stage par laana hai. Kya hum kirdaaron ko @Phrase mein muntaqil kar sakte hain? Shayad ek @Free @Group mein?
$~Chaliye sab log, apni apni jagah par aa jaayein…
